{"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/1175","revision":421531,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"5f0709aa17e564f569f5c0d5a1d3ab88ea2e0a62966cfb81b1670679d85b6a6e","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/A_Vision_Of_The_Past"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Greetings visitor.","The place you are visiting, is nothing but an echo of the past.","This place and I are just visions of a long gone area.","I am what no longer is alive. A mere memory stored in the walls of our fallen fortress.","The last memory of a once proud race, wiped out in their war against the demons.","Once we were numerous. We seeded the world, that the gods entrusted us to protect. We became their champions and wardens in their wars against evil.","We fought in the name of the gods. We fought valiantly. We fought gloriously. Yet ultimately we failed.","We were great soldiers. Many battles were won by our wooden legions by physical prowess, magical insight and the blessings of the gods. Yet we were not prepared for the fury of the inferniarchs. ...","The inferniarchs managed to burn their hellish portals into weak pockets of the rock and from there wormed their way into the bowels of our fortress while we were fighting off their siege engines. ...","Even then we might have stood a chance, but we were not prepared for Rotrender.","He was a massive inferniarch, the wildest and most despicable of them all. Where he walked, the ground was defiled and rot nested. His touch withered our bark and caused us to crumble...","He became the scourge of Azzilon. Our doom. In the end, we lured him into a cave where some of our finest had merged with stone and earth. ...","Their roots collapsed the cave over the fiend, crushing his poisonous body under masses of rock, ending its existence. ...","But the damage had been done, our defences breached. The hordes of the inferniarchs were everywhere. We did not go out without a glorious battle, taking inferniarchs with us in droves. ...","In the end they brought us down though. One by one the defenders fell and at some point even the victorious cackling of the remaining inferniarchs ceased and silence fell over Azzilon, to be forgotten by the world we fought for.","We prepared for the great war to come. We planted the seeds for our future armies all over the world. A legion to behold would have risen, with the passing of the seasons. ...","But before the seeds could flourish, the sheer number of demons and their ferocity overwhelmed us.","The legions were prepared to bloom, but without us to teach the next generation, our once proud race will fall into barbarism and disarray. ...","Or already has, as we are only a faint memory without substance or identity now.","The fortress of Azzilon fell. Our race perished. All our preparations were for naught. Even our ultimate weapon wasn't prepared to save us.","We planted the seed for the ultimate weapon, safely hidden in the deepest depths of the high seas. If it had grown, it would have turned the tide of battle. But we underestimated time.","We thought in the dimensions of trees, time meant little to us. It was an ally at best. But time turned out to become our worst enemy.","Time had run out for us. We lost the next generations that we planted and our folly doomed our civilisation. Our best weapon was not even blossoming, when the demons came. This doomed us all.","This echo is our last legacy, the legacy of a lost race. Let our fate be a reminder for others not to underestimate time. The things you seem to have in abundance may turn on you at some point.","Never forget, that time is precious, even when you seem to have it in abundance."]}

Just name your poison.","Just a figure of speech. Though we also serve actual poison in this tavern. Some people have odd tastes and I don’t question that.","It has been a family business since more generations than I could count. In the old days it was merely a hole where my ancestors hid, when the court guys came for a visit to bash their own heads. …","But soon enough people learned, the courtiers saw it beneath them to become a threat and their fights became a spectacle to watch. One of my ancestors saw a chance to earn some coin and opened a business. …","The fights became a spectacle because of him. His daughter, who took over at some point, even secured some agreements with the courts and made several subtle suggestions that were adopted into the battles. …","More and more it became quite a spectacle in certain circles and the business flourished. Snobbish and so full of themselves. …","But you can get along with them, as long as you know how to handle them and I’m dealing with worse people in this tavern day to day. Not looking at you here, of course.","As you will know, most goblins are not born with many gifts of the mind, so to say. They needed an upper class for a firm guidance, else they’d only manage to get themselves killed.","Of course you can’t entrust meaningful tasks to some goblin who is thick as a brick. They can only do the most simple tasks whereas the smarter ones have to oversee them. …","So it’s only to their best that there is a class who is overseeing and guiding them.","They might not be strong or skilled but there are lots of them. If you just send enough of them to do a job they will eventually get it done. …","Casualties are just a normal thing. The lower classes breed like mad anyway. …","This is why only they recovered from the onslaught of the other races whereas the upper class was nearly extinguished.","I have little use of gods. I think it’s wise not to drawn their attention upon me. So I can have a life of my own and do as I like.","In the past the court guys just cut down each other wherever they met. Then their leaders decided that they did not like to loose their hotheads without their consent, …","so they agreed upon some rules such as formal challenges and a dedicated spot to fight at. With some order established the caverns here were made a bit more cozy and my ancestors opened business. …","Later on some beasts were introduced, that the champions of the houses could fight, and even later foreign gladiators were allowed. …","The catching of beasts and hiring of gladiators was done with the money of my family so they had a slight say in the way the fights were set up. …","To increase the frequency of the fights we finally convinced them to allow strangers to become champions of their houses. Since then the business is prospering like never before.","I consider myself a bit more sophisticated than your average standard goblin. …","My family belongs to a long line of goblin nobility, from the days before our culture was destroyed by other races.","Well, bye then."]}

I am Death and I have waited here for you.","Indeed. But do not fear me. I am not the enemy you expect. I am a companion, a guide, a transition.","I am here to give you perspective. In your journey through Tibia, you have been confronted with darkness and loss. ...","It is natural to fear death, the end of everything you know. But I am not the end. I am a transition.","To something new. Life is a dance, and death is the turn that leads us in a new direction. Every ending is a new beginning, a blank slate, a chance for change. ...","If you ask me the right questions, I can give you the insight you need to successfully complete your journey.","That is true, I take. But I also give something back: peace. Freedom from suffering and pain. And the memory of shared love will remain in your hearts forever.","You can accept me by embracing life. By cherishing every moment, every encounter, every experience. By knowing that everything is fleeting, and that is precisely what makes it so precious. ...","So hear my advice.","Live! Love! Laugh! Cry! Feel! Experience everything life has to offer with all your heart. And when your time comes, go with dignity and without fear. For I will be there to welcome you. ...","Now go on. Your journey is not over. And remember: death is not the end of the story. It is only a chapter. *He turns away, but the conversation leaves you with new thoughts and a deeper understanding*"]}

Not again!","Where is this brat again?","You need a serious beating.","I want some days off.","Greetings, meatbag. Speak quick, my patience is short.","I'm the mother of thousands of demons. If you think they are a pain when they are grown up, you haven't met the young ones. And particularly the babies can be bothersome. ...","I desperately need a few days off or I cannot guarantee for anything!","My little darlings are somewhat tiresome sometimes. And there are hundreds of them. Even I need a rest from time to time. Some time for myself. Do you have any idea for how long I didn't have had my horns done? ...","And it's not easy for a single demon mother to meet an evil guy. As soon as they hear you have a few hundred children at home, they teleport into another dimension! ...","Even demon mothers want to relax now and then, have a bath in the lava pits and listen to the screams of some tortured souls. ...","And I am not the kind of mother that let's her little demons watch the torture pits the whole day. I expect from them to do something creative and evil on their own. ...","I won't drop them into some foreign dimension to take care of their own like other demon mothers do. ...","Of course a torn off head will regrow in a few days but I'm old-fashioned and don't like to see my little darlings suffer. ...","This is where you come in! I entrust this world to take care for my little darlings for a while!","Ah, well. My kids sometimes like it rough. To calm them, I usually slap something hard on their head. Hey, don't give me that look, we are demons after all.","I need some of you mortals to care for some of my children. They are only demon babies so it shouldn't be too hard, even for such limited creatures as you are. ...","I'll hand you one of my babies and you'll take care of it. You can only care for one baby at a time. ...","Demon babies are moody and spoilt. Each few hours it will request something from you and you will have to fulfil its wishes to keep it happy. It will let you know what it wants. ...","Do whatever pleases the baby to satisfy it for a few hours. If you comply with its wishes often enough, it will become cheery. It might take a few days and don't think it's easy. ...","Some of the baby's wishes might be exotic and others outright dangerous. But that is the fate of babysitters since the dawn of time. ...","Bring my darlings back to me as soon as they are cheery. This phase will last for a while and it will be easy for me to keep an eye on them. ...","If enough of your people help me and bring me my cheery darlings, I will be pleased and your world will be rewarded. ...","If you fail though .. well, let's say you will not like this alternative. I can become really mean if I am mad and most demons owe me something! ...","So are you up to this?","Uh ... Uhm ... Really? Fabulous! Here we go! Take care! It is now bound to YOU, so don't try to swap it with another baby. My magic will prevent that and return it to you!","You did surprisingly well in handling my little darling. I might have use for your nanny skills another time.","Are you ready to take care of one of my little darlings for a while?","Hey! I already gave you one of my children! If you have failed to take care of it, it will find me. And then I'll find YOU!","Though I feel like tearing you apart, I can't even blame you. Still, if your world fails, I will make you suffer!","Are you here to bring one of my little darlings back to me?","Brilliant! Your world might actually avert my wrath. We will see.","We are creatures of power and knowledge. We are more diverse than you mortals will ever comprehend. The knowledge and wisdom we have gained in our long lives are paling your fleeting vision of what you think is the world.","Do you really think I have time to think about gods? I have hardly time for a spontaneous prayer that Zathroth may give me some spare time! ...","But I guess he is too busy and can't answer those prayers, so I take the matter into my own hands, just like mothers usually do.","I forbid my children to play there. {"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/1040","revision":401878,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"88c62e705d78db2d8b1e2609f75395a4f55af9726e24ae2ab26f9b1f4b259362","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Domizian"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Greetings, traveller!","I am Domizian.","You might deem me a sage and a scholar.","He is the governor of Edron and grandmaster of the Knights of Banor's Blood. I made his acquaintance some years ago, when he was visiting Darashia.","In case you talk about the werehyaena alpha leader: Her name is Rhargu. She lives deep down in the werehyaena lairs together with her pack.","She's a werehyaena. The leader of the pack that causes so much trouble around Darashia.","Of course, let me see what you have.","So, Daniel Steelsoul sent you? He is a most respectable man and I'm honoured to know him. It is of advantage that you have already dealt with the were-sickness so you won't hurl yourself into this adventure unprepared. ...","Listen, the curse has indeed spread to the Darama Desert - but not recently. It exists here since a long time but only few know about it. Here, it's not werewolves or werebears. The danger that plagues this region are the werehyaenas. ...","Until now they were savage and smelly beasts who hunted down a travelling merchant now and then. But mostly they stayed in their subterranean lairs and lived off carrion. ...","But a few weeks ago something changed. Suddenly they had shamans, something I never saw before. Those shamans are using bone talismans and paint their fur with runes. Runes I saw just once before ... on an artefact from Drefia. ...","I'm afraid the werehyaenas have a kind of pact with the undead of Drefia but I don't have proof. Please go to their lairs and investigate. You will find the entrance north of the town, at a large standing stone. ...","Be careful down there, though! Werehyaenas might not be the only danger you will have to face. I heard strange stories about blood pools, a talking skull and even liches.","So, the werehyaenas are indeed working together with Drefia's undead. That's very dangerous, to say the least. Please, if you can, find a way to stop this.","I guess you need something holy or at least blessed to destroy this evil site. The werelions know a ritual that allows you to bless fire in general. It should work with this torch, too. ...","But you can do that only at a special altar in our sanctum. Go to the Lion's Rock in the north-west of Darashia. Descend to the area where the most noble lions are guarding a secret entrance. ...","There is a door, you can only open if you know the right phrase. It is: 'The sun guides our hearts. The moon guards our dreams'. Down there you will find a room with a mosaic, showing a sun and a moon. ...","There is an altar where you can bless the torch. You have to find a lion mane flower and chop the petals up small. Then sprinkle the chopped petals into the flame while standing at the altar. ...","Thus, the fire will be blessed and should be able to burn down the evil bone shrine.","You destroyed the pact between the werehyaenas and the undead! You did Darashia a great favour, that's for sure. But there are still so many of them, they could be a real threat to the caravans that try to reach the city. ...","Please, kill three hundred of those ferocious werehyaenas and their shamans.","Yes, there are less of them now! What a relief for Darashia. Well, I guess, now I can trust you enough to tell you a little secret about myself. I'm actually a werelion. Don't be scared, though. ...","There's something special to the werelions: We can control the curse and don't attack people like mindless beasts. This is the reason why I can live here in the city and talk to you in such a civilized way. ...","Well, the werehyaenas were a danger to Darashia but they also caused a very personal problem for me. Look, I assumed that they are up to something and that this something could be the undead in Drefia. ...","I warned our king, Heliodor, about it but he didn't believe me. I insisted and got short-tempered - which is never a good idea in the presence of your king. He exiled me as punishment for my impudence. ...","This is the reason why I live here in Darashia. This city has its conveniences but I would like to return to my pride. Please find Heliodor and tell him about the werehyaenas' pact with the undead. ...","Take this ring, it will allow you to enter the lower part of the sanctum. Wear it while you touch one of the lion columns in the centre of the sanctum's upper floor. Then you will reach the lower part.","The werelions are special among the therianthropes. We are not weak-willed victims of the curse. We control it. That means we can change form at will and are not feral beasts as soon as the full moon rises.","Therianthropy is the ability of human beings to metamorphose into other animals. The most well known form of therianthropy is found in stories concerning werewolves. ...","But there are many others, too, like bears, hyaenas or lions.","You found Heliodor and told him about the werehyaenas? He will consider to pardon me? I don't know how I could thank you! Take this as a small compensation for your efforts!","My king will consider to pardon me! Thank you again!","Farewell."]}

What are you doing in this realm?","This is the realm of Devovorga.","She slumbers, and she dreams... at least what is left of her essence.","The essence of Devovorga is trapped in this realm. Are you here to help me fight them?","There are five incarnations of Devovorga's essence: Anmothra, Teneshpar, Irahsae, Phrodomo and Chikhaton. If you're ready to fight one of them, you can give me tentacle pieces and I'll prepare your body to pass the gate that leads to them.","The soul of Devovorga. Would you like to give me 2 tentacle pieces and fight this incarnation?","You may now enter the gate to the south as soon as the room is free. You have then 10 minutes to fight Anmothra. ...","If your powers fail you, you can flee from the fight - but you'll have to give me tentacle pieces again to gain another chance. Would you like to give me 5 tentacle pieces and fight this incarnation?","You may now enter the gate to the south as soon as the room is free. You have then 10 minutes to fight Irahsae. ...","If your powers fail you, you can flee from the fight - but you'll have to give me tentacle pieces again to gain another chance. {"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/608","revision":355623,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"96fd38f2480a322f4db2708b831d382da9adb6e71857e13344b8a812b85e7572","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Ghost_Captain"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Greetings Jogador! Are you ready to help me?","Read the manuals that should be lying around here. Some of my former helpers wrote all that stuff down to assist those who might come after them. ...","It is IMPORTANT that you understand the procedure. As soon as we embark on our journey, we will have only a few moments to get to the battle stations until the trouble begins. ...","It's not easy to sail through the netherworld, so don't make it harder by missing vital facts.","You have to man all stations. Each station must be attended by one person. Read the manual over there, it will help you significantly. ...","You'll have to act swiftly and correctly, else we'll lose our chance to chart the waters of the nether. If you fail on your duties on the ship, we have lost this opportunity, too.","If we fail, I will have to gather new strength and we have to try it anew after a while.","I've lost my name along with the chance to pass into the afterlife. One day I may have a name again, but only to be mourned since I will finally rest in peace then.","What do you think? I'm dead and forgotten. I'm just a shadow of the man I used to be. I'm a ghost now.","Just like me, my ship is not from this world anymore. We belong to another world now and it's hard to pass into the world of the living. ...","I can twist myself through the barrier sometimes but to get my ship through it requires more power than I've got available. For this reason we needed the power of the spectral scum you caught earlier. ...","This way we do not only put those lost souls to rest, but also gather the energy that is needed to get the ship through the barrier of worlds. With my ship here, we might be able to reach the Mourning Isles.","The Mourning Isles are a place of dread and despair. Since ancient times it has been a place where pirates of many races and nations hid their treasures and left unwanted individuals to await their death. ...","Often the treacherous waters of the isles sunk ships and stranded their crews on these godforsaken rocks. Many people died and cursed the isles. ...","So these isles are haunted since the dawn of mankind. The ghosts there lured even more ships on the reefs and the dreaded fame of the isles made them a popular hiding and detention spot. ...","Nowadays, no ordinary ship would manage to reach this isle. But my ghost ship might make it. ...","I will not lie to you though. Our journey will probably be as futile as all others before. ...","But with each successful try we are getting a bit closer to the isle. We just have to stand the perils of the nether long enough so that I can complete my maps of the nether a bit more. ...","Even if I won't reach the isle during your lifetime, your help will never be forgotten my friend.","Over the centuries, my ship has become more of an entity than an ordinary ghost ship. ...","It's been my only ally throughout the ages, well almost. We've been through a lot of tough things and I want you to treat my ship with respect. ...","The most living parts of the ship, save for the hull itself, are the soul core and the spirit flame. ...","You can reach the ship by using the mechanism in the south. Four of you have to stand on the plates when one of you pulls the lever. All of you have to be aligned to the same spirit mark though.","The hull is made by spectral wood and can easily stand the spirit storms of the netherworld. Still, it is a great danger that the wood is satiated so much with spirit energy that is becomes a feast for those damn ghost rats. ...","Gladly we still have some good old ghost dusters in the ship, they'll teach them a lesson. Still, these rats can do considerable damage to the hull if no one takes care of them.","It's hard to describe what it is exactly. I'd call it the ship's heart and soul. ...","You can literally see the ship's health and well-being by inspecting the core. If the core is damaged, it is a really baaaad thing, you know!? ...","The good thing is that soul sparks, which are quite common in these parts of the netherworld, emit a strengthening aura that can fix any damage of the core. ...","They have to be led to the core though since they are only attracted by living creatures.","The flame is what keeps the ship moving. Elements are not common here in the netherworld and are a powerful source of energy. ...","The spirit flame charges itself on energy of certain elements. These elements have to be distributed to the corresponding shrines. ...","When a shrine obtains the correct energy charge, it fuels the spiritual force of the ship and reinvigorates the spirit flame in return. ...","If this delicate balance were ever to break, we would lose our energy source and couldn't continue our travel through the netherworld or even strand here.","Good bye, Jogador."]}

Are you ready to help me?","Read the manuals that should be lying around here. Some of my former helpers wrote all that stuff down to assist those who might come after them. ...","It is IMPORTANT that you understand the procedure. As soon as we embark on our journey, we will have only a few moments to get to the battle stations until the trouble begins. ...","It's not easy to sail through the netherworld, so don't make it harder by missing vital facts.","You have to man all stations. Each station must be attended by one person. Read the manual over there, it will help you significantly. ...","You'll have to act swiftly and correctly, else we'll lose our chance to chart the waters of the nether. If you fail on your duties on the ship, we have lost this opportunity, too.","If we fail, I will have to gather new strength and we have to try it anew after a while.","I've lost my name along with the chance to pass into the afterlife. One day I may have a name again, but only to be mourned since I will finally rest in peace then.","What do you think? I'm dead and forgotten. I'm just a shadow of the man I used to be. I'm a ghost now.","Just like me, my ship is not from this world anymore. We belong to another world now and it's hard to pass into the world of the living. ...","I can twist myself through the barrier sometimes but to get my ship through it requires more power than I've got available. For this reason we needed the power of the spectral scum you caught earlier. ...","This way we do not only put those lost souls to rest, but also gather the energy that is needed to get the ship through the barrier of worlds. With my ship here, we might be able to reach the Mourning Isles.","The Mourning Isles are a place of dread and despair. Since ancient times it has been a place where pirates of many races and nations hid their treasures and left unwanted individuals to await their death. ...","Often the treacherous waters of the isles sunk ships and stranded their crews on these godforsaken rocks. Many people died and cursed the isles. ...","So these isles are haunted since the dawn of mankind. The ghosts there lured even more ships on the reefs and the dreaded fame of the isles made them a popular hiding and detention spot. ...","Nowadays, no ordinary ship would manage to reach this isle. But my ghost ship might make it. ...","I will not lie to you though. Our journey will probably be as futile as all others before. ...","But with each successful try we are getting a bit closer to the isle. We just have to stand the perils of the nether long enough so that I can complete my maps of the nether a bit more. ...","Even if I won't reach the isle during your lifetime, your help will never be forgotten my friend.","Over the centuries, my ship has become more of an entity than an ordinary ghost ship. ...","It's been my only ally throughout the ages, well almost. We've been through a lot of tough things and I want you to treat my ship with respect. ...","The most living parts of the ship, save for the hull itself, are the soul core and the spirit flame. ...","You can reach the ship by using the mechanism in the south. Four of you have to stand on the plates when one of you pulls the lever. All of you have to be aligned to the same spirit mark though.","The hull is made by spectral wood and can easily stand the spirit storms of the netherworld. Still, it is a great danger that the wood is satiated so much with spirit energy that is becomes a feast for those damn ghost rats. ...","Gladly we still have some good old ghost dusters in the ship, they'll teach them a lesson. Still, these rats can do considerable damage to the hull if no one takes care of them.","It's hard to describe what it is exactly. I'd call it the ship's heart and soul. ...","You can literally see the ship's health and well-being by inspecting the core. If the core is damaged, it is a really baaaad thing, you know!? ...","The good thing is that soul sparks, which are quite common in these parts of the netherworld, emit a strengthening aura that can fix any damage of the core. ...","They have to be led to the core though since they are only attracted by living creatures.","The flame is what keeps the ship moving. Elements are not common here in the netherworld and are a powerful source of energy. ...","The spirit flame charges itself on energy of certain elements. These elements have to be distributed to the corresponding shrines. ...","When a shrine obtains the correct energy charge, it fuels the spiritual force of the ship and reinvigorates the spirit flame in return. ...","If this delicate balance were ever to break, we would lose our energy source and couldn't continue our travel through the netherworld or even strand here.","Good bye, Jogador."],"npc_lines_semantics":"source_utterances_without_trigger_or_state_assignment","profession":"nieznany","quest_references":[{"label":"A Pirate's Death to Me","url":"https://tibiopedia.pl/quests/A_Pirates_Death_To_Me"}],"specialty":null,"tp_coordinate_frame":"tibiopedia-map-pixels-floor-unverified","tp_map_markers":[[2346,3382,7]],"tp_trade_available":"nie","tp_trade_reference":{"BuyFromPlayer":{},"SellToPlayer":{}},"voices_text":null}}

{"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/679","revision":357475,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"fd52632d4dc5daf02f0737b23eee016fa4aaa504a20ca7c8056ed6b42d9a9eeb","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Knightmare_(NPC)"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Hello Jogador and welcome. I guess you are here to talk about my job or to get your present!","Here you are! Have fun.","World-builder, god, sage, storyteller. All of it fits in it's limited way. I for myself would humbly settle for storyteller since this is what interests me the most and seems most important. ...","A great deal of Tibia's background was created by me or based on my ideas. As far as the greater concept is concerned, there are still so incredibly many things to be told, I hope to fit them in one by one whenever possible.","I am known as Knightmare, though it was not my first choice of a name. The name I initially thought of was already taken. ...","In hindsight it's probably better to be known as Knightmare as my other choice seems rather dumb to me today. Dumb enough to not mention it at least <wink>.","I always felt that been called a god is a bit exaggerated. I could use some of my not-so-godly powers to get you out if you are stuck here.","Do you want to be teleported to the temple in Thais?","Well I have not only created a great deal of Tibia but I have also witnessed all of its glorious and darker moments over the years. Have you ever known the story about urine? ...","Or how about what happened to the Thaian drawbridge? Have you heard what problems the most early runes have caused? Or did you know about the evolution of monsters and how the level system changed over the years? ...","Perhaps you might rather hear about the mysteries of ancient Tibia or would you rather learn about the old player houses? ...","Once upon a time the northern drawbridge of Thais was fully operational. Though it could be used to block at least one path into the city and annoy other players it worked quite well until the number of players grew. ...","The city became increasingly inaccessible from the north, but some players enjoyed hunting those responsible for lifting the drawbridge or even started to guard the lever. ...","The deathblow for the drawbridge came from an unexpected side though. It was the fishing that made the drawbridge inoperative. ...","Since the server distinguished between fishable and temporally not fishable tiles, it was unable to reset tiles that were not fishable as it expected them to be. ...","That sometimes lead to holes in the bridge that were a rare myth for a while, but soon became more and more common. ...","After figuring out that the bridge mechanics had to be changed in any case, it was decided to lock the bridge once and for all and to allow undisturbed access to the city.","Runes were originally introduced as a quick and easy way to target spells. Still, they were not as unproblematic as first thought and they caused several unforeseen problems. ...","The first runes worked in a quite simple way. The server was just told which rune was used on which target and it faithfully applied the effects. ...","This caused several problems though, since it assumed real players would use the runes in the real game as intended. ...","Of course this was not always the case. First of all, though the server checked if there was a blockade between user and target it did not check for the proximity of user and target as well. ...","So a manipulated client could theoretically use a rune from one end of the world to the other as long as there was nothing blocking it. This was a clear exploit and was eliminated fast though. ...","It got more complicated when it came to using runes on another level though. ...","In the past it was possible to use runes on something you saw, that was not blocked and in range. That meant though, that you could use runes from a roof on some creature in the street. ...","The problems with this approach were numerous. Monsters could not target someone on another level and not even change levels. So it resulted in many easy or at least risk free kills of some of the strongest creatures in Tibia. ...","The demon in particular had quite often been the target of such attacks. It also became quite popular to attack other players using this method. Not only was the attacker not easily reached, the client would not display multilevel effects. ...","That meant you did not even see the attacks coming and only with some luck noticed your hit-points dropping while having a chat with a friend in town. ...","Though originally a feature and not strictly a bug, the mechanic was deemed as too problematic and abusable, so it was dropped for good.","With the introduction of magic and vocations several creatures entered the world of Tibia for the first time. ...","With the original player characters transferred to the new system the new monsters were quite a challenge with the characters being low levelled, untrained and inexperienced. ...","Minotaurs, ghouls and the then differently named bonelords were really dangerous for the heroes of that time. Drama struck when high levelled and prominent players got trapped in a cave full of bonelords and ghouls. ...","Some of the most experienced players were thrashed soundly by some minotaurs when they ventured too far into the depths of new dungeons. ...","Dragons, who were introduced along with them, were seen as only killable by a strong group of experienced players for a while and demons were seen as beyond the reach of ordinary players. ...","But the new monsters used the old AI and hadn't learnt any new tricks yet. ...","That lead to new and quite effective strategies that were sometimes dubious at least, as a common rat, a dragon or demon could be blocked or trapped by some chests or flower pots. ...","To make things even more easy, invisibility worked on all monsters, regardless of power. So soon you could see invisible mages kill the mighty demons en masse - well actually you could NOT see them of course but they did it nonetheless! ...","So, after a while new AI options were introduced and the balance of power was somewhat restored.","Over the years some things changed and others remained the same. In the past we had no noses and no eyes, BUT we could pee! ...","You could use some empty container on yourself and would fill it with urine. Technically speaking player characters were walking urine containers. ...","And even better! You would never run out of urine. If you had enough containers if you went for a pee, only the sky was the limit in a way! ...","Of course people preferred the see-through vials as containers to proudly present the liquid gold they just created. ...","Of course those days were not only that ... uhm golden. Urine attacks became more and more common. Mad men (and women alike) assaulted harmless bystanders with bottled urine and sprinkled it everywhere. ...","Cities were cluttered with urine vials and pools. With concern the gods saw their lovely cities slowly drowning in the yellow flood. So one day they decided to cut off ... the urine supply. ...","It was an astonishingly painless process and, after a first panic, theories of people spontaneously exploding from inner pressure could be dismissed. But the gods went a step too far. ...","They did not only stop the urine from flowing, they also changed all existing urine into lemonade - which was a bit disturbing, even though it was done with the best intentions. ...","Also now the dungeons were filled with odd rooms in which the monsters obviously hoarded and spilled lemonade. ...","It took some intervention on my part to finally bring back urine in some form. I could convince CIP to add back the urine for ... uhm 'flavour' reasons. And so at last the urine made its humble return into the world that it had once ruled.","Even the old Tibia had some riddles and mysteries in store. ...","One of the first I encountered was the lighthouse south west of Thais. Together with a friend I made while fighting through the sewers and dungeons of Tibia, we acquired the treasure hidden there. ...","I think it was the helmet of the stars in those days. ...","Another minor riddle was a key to the acient temple (aka the rotworm-place north of Thais). If I remember correctly, after finding the key and surviving the rotworms you got the magic plate armour. ...","I think the firesword and or the magic longsword were available too but I cannot recall where they were found. Perhaps there was a weapon in the temple rather than the armor. ...","I vaguely remember that my friend got a weapon and I a piece of armor in our first run - only to lose both when we faced a horde of orcs in one of the dungeons. Sometime later another treasure room was introduced. ...","It contained several items like rings and at least one spellsrcoll (which you used in those days to learn rare spells or spells not usually available for your profession). You could see the treasures from outside, but getting in was the real problem. ...","It was so exciting to come up with new ideas about where to enter the rooms. Every now and then we had a new idea and travelled to the treasure room to test it. We never succeeded - it was still fun and memorable though. ...","The room finally got breached by a bug, though without bad intentions. The room eventually got deleted and the items contained within found their way into the game through other sources. ...","At least one other treasure room not many were even aware of, was deleted without the public even noticing the existence of the riddle. Still, after all those years the hunt for these treasures is still one of the most vivid in my tibian career.","Bidding on houses on the website and having owner rights and the like is a comfort that the pioneers of Tibia did not enjoy. ...","There were only a few houses available. They were distributed by a volunteer from the player base (one of the Gamemasters). ...","If you were chosen for one of the houses, you were handed a physical (well virtual tibia-physical of course) key to lock and unlock the rooms. ...","You had to think twice whom you admit into your rooms. You had to even think twice whether it was safe to get your precious key and enter your house without the risk of loosing it. ...","Everyone could log out in a house and you had no chance to remove an unwanted guest save by force. The whole system was as fragile and vulnerable for problems as it sounds. ...","With more and more players, let alone worlds, it would have soon become intolerable. ...","I can't retell after all those years if the system came to an end before an update changed it or what update it was that introduced houses as you know them. ...","I guess when the premium system came we already had a bidding system, I vaguely remember adding rentable rooms, houses and shops when I created Edron which was the first pure premium area back then. ...","However the key system that had been used in several minor quests, has fallen into obscurity more and more due to all the problems it is causing in a living and changing environment. ...","With all its rustic charm I highly doubt such a house system would even remotely work in our days, let alone the horror the support would have to endure due to lost or misplaced keys.","The first gamemasters were hand-picked players that were the most active in forums and in corresponding with CIP. ...","I can not recall how many we were, nor all the names. Yorin and me were amongst the first ones. I am not 100 percent sure about the others. ...","With a growing player base more and more GMs were taken on and a system for finding new ones had to be introduced. The first guidelines for finding new GMs were a number of recommendations from other GMs and no GM objecting to them. ...","It was all quite rough and we had little orders what to do and how to handle things. All this stuff was established by learning by doing and discussing those topics on the forums. ...","We had to decide what behaviour was acceptable and how much player-killing was bearable and what was excessive. We had no counter or indicator though to see anything about player-killings at all. ...","We had only a few witnesses now and then and usually a supposed victim and the supposed murderer. It was impossible to see who was telling the truth and so a less strict policy was necessary. ...","The best we could do was to stop someone from running amok in Thais. ...","Also we had no separate GM-characters in those days. Although we could teleport to a player who reported a bug or a player-killer or whatever, we would not be invulnerable getting there which could easily get you killed accidentally. ...","So the system was quite shaky and problematic but it built the foundations of the later GM-System with its rules and head GMs and even in some way for the customer support.","One funny thing about NPCs is that they once could actually cast spells for some odd reason. When an NPC would say the words that belonged to a spell he would cast it as if he were a player. ...","That is how the innocent spell teacher north of Thais accidently murdered a few people who asked him for wave or beam spells until this was changed.","After the players adjusted to the new monsters it did not take long for the once challenging dragons to become more and more huntable for single players. More and more players joined the game and more and more reached higher levels. ...","The demand for opponents was high and the supply low. ...","Still a student project, Tibia lacked the resources to add considerable amounts of land masses, let alone new dungeons. Even with the help of volunteers adding new land was painfully slow for several reasons. ...","To ease the demand for more monsters several new spawns were added. One of them should soon become infamous. Just east of Thais, not that far from the city-gate a considerable dragon spawn was added. ...","Given the number of high levelled players, none of the dragons that spawned there lived for long, ...","but some poor new players that in those days started in Thais most certainly ran right away into a hungry dragon on his first expedition at less crowded times. ...","However the loot of the dragons in those days was considerable. As far as I remember, they dropped the helmet of the stars, magic plate armor and possibly even a magic longsword. ...","At least they dropped fire swords. Those were the most powerful items of that time. ...","Although not a common drop, the sheer number of killed dragons lead to a situation where everyone had stored a few sets away in his depot, and no-one was willing to buy one of them. So together with dragon corpses those items began to litter the east. ..","If you created a new character, all you had to do was to run to the east and grab the stuff before you caught the attention of a dragon. For a while this was the status quo until the introduction of new areas brought a rebalance of monsters and items. ...","The aforementioned items were turned into junk or at least common weapons and armor. The new system made the more powerful items considerably more rare and introduced them to the game at a more reasonable rate. ...","Allthough the situation described before might seem like the land of milk and honey, there was no big uproar in the player base since the change was obviously for the better. ...","Hm, thinking about it, seeing as how in our days even minor resets and pure positive additions are bashed, it may after all have been the land of milk and honey in some regards indeed <wink>.","Don't we all love CipSoft?","I have seen Thais growing from a tiny settlement into a busy metropolis. Most of its inhabitants are somewhat of my children. I created and rewrote several of them.","Venore is based on an early draft I had for Carlin. I wanted to create a pyramid city in the water. ...","After things worked out otherwise I used the idea for Venore but since I did not like to make it too similar to its real-life counterpart Venice I used swamp instead of water.","Carlin was basically built by GM Maegwyn but left without a concept for NPCs and history. I created most of its NPCs and its culture and finally fitted it into Tibian history.","I took over Ab'Dendriel from its former editor after he abandoned the project. Good you're showing up","I've never considered to follow a profession. But people tend to call me a swamp witch because I sometimes make brews with unusual ingredients in my cauldron. So I guess that is what I am.","Not all witches are evil. Neither do all of us fit into such simple categories like good and evil at all. ...","In these days, several of us work for a common cause and put our differences aside for a greater goal. ...","I think there is a lot to learn from this and I hope it will somehow be an inspiration for others.","We need the ingredients and we need many of them. We gather supplies the whole year and prepare most of the brew in advance. ...","But with our numbers dwindling, we need more and more help of the Tibians to save the world. You might gain our favour by helping us in our mission.","The cauldron is ancient and sacred to us. It bears powerful enchantments and years of use in rituals have changed its very structure in the fabric of reality.","The brew is not ready by far. We are just beginning and there is much left to be done.","By sacrificing items for our cause or igniting the cauldron's fire you will gain some favour within our circle. ...","We are willing to trade certain potions to you. Your current favour is 2.","We offer mana potions, strong mana potions and great mana potions. We also offer health potions, strong health potions, great health potions and ultimate health potions. And we offer great spirit potions.","Sorry, your favour is not high enough.","I am known as Minzy.","We have to hold the ritual in these days when they are strongest. They might even manifest now and then harass us in our ritual with the help of rotten dead things . ...","But this is nothing compared to their wrath if we should fail the ritual. We would have to wait a whole year to try a new ritual and had to endure the malignant attacks of the bane bringers in the meantime.","The bane bringers work in a very subtle way. You might lose connection to a dear friend, have considerable streaks of bad luck or make new enemies. ...","Perhaps they'd let something of your possession vanish or make you look like a cheater or liar through some strange coincidence. The worst thing they do is eating away your luck and happiness though.","One would guess the trade barons could easily spare the ingredients for the brew, but they won't lift a finger and call us superstitious fools. ...","In the past, they even sent mercenaries to disrupt our ritual but our resistance proved too expensive for their tastes. Still, we failed to complete the ritual that year and many suffered.","I won't share my knowledge with strangers. Besides, there is little I know that would be of any practical use at all for you.","He has stolen much of his knowledge from several sources. The community of witches suffered particularly from his greed. ...","We will not forget this. Although, some misguided souls sell themselves to him for some of the stolen and now lost knowledge in return.","Weapons, weapons. Is this all you people care about? The bane bringer threat is a far more imminent event. This should be our focus.","Take care my friend."]}

{"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/1088","revision":413313,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"1cae446682dddeb2d1ca1e7f41cd1904362860988190fcc639d6b08a2afff21e","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Nihaka"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Branch-sleeping. I just don't get it ...","It's moa hunting season soon.","Ahh, sweet Candra.","Greetings, two-leg.","I'm the maharani's son, so I guess you could call me a prince.","My name is Nihaka.","I'm not sure. Is this important to you?","The asuri once lived in Marapur, but were expelled and banished from there. Since then they have been trying to return several times. Sometimes a few of them succeed, but they are usually quickly driven away by our warriors and shamans. ...","But my mother and our shaman think, that right now the asuri try to wreak havoc from the shadows by influencing nagas with dark magic so that they become increasingly animalistic and attack their fellows.","My mother is Saraki, our maharani.","The coastal nagas live in Silvertides and on the surroundings isles. At the beginning of the period we call 'the Rising', they still made great efforts to push the water back and keep it away from the island. ...","In the meantime, however, they have accepted that the water and the land coalesce more and more. They regard it as a part of their lives and even a part of themselves.","Silvertides is the city of the coast folk. You can find it in the south of Marapur, on one of the larger islands.","This is our city here in the Stardance Mountains. We built it thousands of years ago. It got its name after a story which is very well kown amongst the nagas.","A rather poetic name, yes. And with good reason. Of course, there is a story behind it.","Since the beginning of our existence, we nagas have worshipped the moon goddess Amati. She always stood high in the sky, looking down on us benevolently and lighting up the nights. ...","Although we love the warmth of the suns, it is the moon that moves the sea, creating the tides. That can charge solid water with energy. That strengthens our magical powers. We think of the moon as a queen and the stars as her many maids. ...","But once, in her wanderings across the night sky, Amati took a misstep and fell. She plummeted down, right above Marapur and landed in the Stardance Mountains. Hurt and alone, she didn't know how to get back up into the sky. ...","And the stars missed her bitterly. Moon and stars shed many tears and mourned many nights - dark nights, without Amati's light in the sky. But then the stars decided to do something they had never done before: ...","They descended from the sky and surrounded the fallen moon. Here, in these mountains, they began a magical dance. And lo and behold, Amati was healed and, with the help of the stars, was able to rise into the sky again. ...","This is why the mountains in the centre of Marapur are called the Stardance Mountains and our city Moonfall. For it was at this very spot that Amati had fallen.","That's what we call it, yes. The rising of the sea level and the flooding of Marapur began centuries ago. But it progresses very slowly, so we are not forced to flee. ...","The coast folk down there in Silvertides have strongly integrated the Rising into their culture and way of life. The so-called coastal nagas adapt to living with the water and take advantage of its benefits instead of resisting it. ...","We, the mountain nagas, live in the Stardance Mountains that have not yet been affected by the Rising. Because of this, there are some cultural differences, for example in terms of religious customs, diet and lifestyle.","Female nagas lay eggs, but they do not take care of them themselves. Instead, they give them to larger nests for breeding. There, brood helpers take care of the eggs and also of the small nagas when they hatch. ...","Our hatchlings become independent quite quickly and reach the stage of a somewhat six-year-old human child after only one year. Then they are sent back to their parents, who take care of their education. ...","Or to one of the parents in case they are no longer in a relationship. Which happens quite often, because we rarely form longer, monogamous relationships. But with Candra, it's different! We will stay together!","Our mythology knows a story, why these turtles have two heads: In the conflict between asuri and nagas, they would not choose one side. While the nagas offered wisdom to the turtles, the asuri offered them food. ...","Indecisive and hesitant, the animals turned their heads back and forth between the two parties so often that they ended up with two heads - and neither food nor wisdom.","Moas are herbivorous birds and feed mainly on buds, leaves and the fruits of jungle plants. They also have a preference for shiny or glittering objects. ...","If they spot these and can snatch them without major risk, the birds will often steal such items and hide them in their nests.","Parders are good climbers, but due to the omnipresence of water they have also developed into good swimmers and like to catch fish. For us nagas, they hardly pose a threat. ...","Be careful, though, two-leg: Parders prey on humanoid bipeds.","In earlier times, we often domesticated the makara to serve as pack and working animals. ...","However, when we discovered that the giant beavers native to Marapur were easier to tame and less costly to care for and feed, we turned away from domesticating makara.","Because of their elemental bodies, it is often difficult to distinguish foam stalkers from the water around them. As they roam the reefs, they often capture coral branches, flotsam, pearls or small fish with their swirling bodies. ...","These objects can then be seen swirling around in their watery shapes.","If you want to send a letter or parcel to someone, ask Amra at the post office here in Moonfall.","Asphota sells tools at the market of Silvertides.","She is the love of my life, two-leg. Her scales are blue as the deep sea, shining bright like sapphires. Her voice is like music and she can be quite funny, too! ...","I'll spend the rest of my life with her, I don't care what is said about family by the elders.","He is one of the coastal nagas' beaver keepers.","If you want to sell some gems, Giri is the one you should ask. You can find him at the market here in Moonfall.","She is a young two-leg from Issavi and is selling two-leg friendly furniture at the market here in Moonfall.","Isika sells ammunition at the market of Silvertides.","Kaumudi is one of our hatch-mothers. That means she cares for the eggs of all of Moonfall's nagas.","He is the raja of the coast folk. You would call him a king, I guess. A kind and patient man who takes his responsibilities very seriously. He is very beloved by the coastal nagas as well as his daughter Candra.","Nipuna is selling wands and runes at the market of Silvertides.","She is my mother, the mountain folk's maharani. You would call her a queen, I guess. She is resolute and strong-minded but also very just towards all of her subjects.","He is Sissek's brother and arrived together with him from Zao, a long time ago. He runs the tavern in the House of Rest and Wisdom here in Moonfall.","He is a two-leg but a different kind of biped than you are. Scaly all over, like our lower bodies. He came here from Zao a long time ago. Until then we didn't know what a bank was. But he established one here in Moonfall.","She is a gifted alchemist and is selling potions at the market here in Moonfall.","He is the coast folk's shaman. He is a powerful wave shaper and one of the wisest tide sages, according to what I have heard.","Timira is a very well known sage and philosopher amongst my people. But I'm afraid, I can't talk about her at the moment. It's a rather unfortunate story but one my mother doesn't want me to discuss with everyone, I'm sorry.","She is our astronomer and has a laboratory slightly away from the city. She has vast knowledge about the night sky and the star constellations.","She is our shaman. You can find her high up above Moonfall in the sanctum of the mountain spirits. My mother Saraki highly appreciates her wise advice.","He has a magic carpet with which he can fly through the air. If you ask him, he might be able to fly you to other islands or continents.","Farewell and safe slithering."]}

I can also give you information on prizes and fees.","First thing to know: dying here will not cost you anything, except the fee you need to pay for each match. You will keep all your experience, skills and loot. ...","After a fight has been initiated by giving me the necessary details, a timer will be started. ...","If you can survive all waves of monsters, you may receive a prize and earn a place in the hall of fame. ...","The fight will be cancelled if the predetermined number of players for a fight does not show up in the anteroom. ...","If a wave is in progress but players take too long and cannot finish all monsters within the time limit, the fight will be cancelled as well.","Every premium player can participate in the monster arena. To initiate the first wave, just talk to me and tell me if you want to play. ...","If the arena is not occupied, you will then be able to tell me how many players will take part. You can also create solo matches.","Surviving a full battle over 10 waves will grant you a reward based on the difficulty level you have selected. Please talk to my assistant right next to the arena entrance for more information on how to claim your reward.","Initiating a fight against monsters in the arena will require an entrance fee of 1000 gold. Please make sure to have enough money on your bank account before setting up a fight.","Staying here most of the time, waiting for new arrivals, counting bodies and occasionally I get into the action myself - when nobody's looking.","Robert. You can call me Red Robert. Nice to meet you.","Good, let's do battle. Remember that you can cancel a setup any time. Are you ready to assemble your team?","Good fight, good night."]}

Intruder!","I'm Rhargu.","I'm the leader of this werehyaena pack.","Sounds like a stupid lion name.","Go away or we'll eat you!","None of your business, the undead! On the other hand .. they haven't done so much for us. Gave us some talismans for our shamans. But no food! I asked for it. They never brought it. ...","If you bring me the food I wish for, I could end this. Or tell you how to end it. But you have to bring me a boar haunch, those are so tasty! And a hard-boiled hydra egg. Always wanted to try one. ...","Also, take this cask and fill it with salted cave rats. My favourite snack! At last, bring me five lion manes. Want to decorate my cave with them, grhrr.","My best guess? Hunt down a boar.","Find a hydra, find its egg.","Catch some cave rats and salt them. It's really that simple. Use a net or something, I don't care.","Kill some lions and cut it off, huh.","Do you have my food?","Give me! And take this. A special torch, made of sandalwood. Burn down the bone shrine at the dragon skeleton with this torch. That will destroy the connection with the undead. ...","And I have a little reward for you. Take this cask. It's funny but smelly. You can have it.","Yes, go away!"]}

{"observations":[],"sources":[{"access_method":"EXISTING_COMMITTED_PUBLIC_API_SNAPSHOT_READ_OFFLINE","kind":"BR_WIKI_IDENTITY_SPEECH_FACTS","pointer":"/pages/604","revision":355556,"snapshot_sha256":"0773232ddd356be273474be7b3aea645ed5dbbf93e5832a94d565ad9e579657a","source_sha256":"fbaa7599a959ec427e123537226e6366f8fab4961ad2a5b3f46ea78a2e149b81","url":"https://www.tibiawiki.com.br/wiki/Smaralda"}],"unassigned_wiki_speech":["Welcome Jogador! Let us talk about fate.","Fate is a road that we all travel but rarely notice. Long ago I have bound my fate to that of a pirate whose name can't be spoken anymore. ...","I try to ease his gruesome fate with my abilities.","The good old captain was never one of the evil bandits of the seas but a gentleman robber who actually fought for freedom and against slavery. ...","Of all the things, good or bad he did in his life, the most fateful was a promise he made to his people to bring back a holy icon that other pirates had robbed while he was away. ...","He tracked the icon to the Mourning Isles but there he met his cruel fate and died without fulfilling his promise.","These isles seemed to be cursed by the gods even before the first living beings arrived there. Since then they've had a history of pain, treachery and desolation. But the lure of its treasures is still strong. ...","Many would try to brave the undead inhabitants of the isles to rob them of their treasure but there is no ship of the living that can still reach the isles.","No ordinary ship can hope to reach the legendary Mourning Isles. But there is one ship that could do it! It is the ship of the old pirate. ...","In these days he is looking for a crew of mortals to help him end his self-imposed curse.","The old pirate made a promise to return an icon from the Mourning Isles. A promise he could not fulfil. ...","Again and again he is looking for helpers that will allow him to summon his ship to this world and reach these cursed isles to finally find that icon. ...","You might be able to help him, but only after my soul seeing reveals which spirit mark will govern your life for the next cycle. ...","Even then you will have to find three others with the same spirit mark bound to them to provide the pirate with a strong and capable crew.","You are marked by the \"Seu Espiríto\".","There are spirits all around us. Some are close to the world of the living, some are far away. Some of them sympathize with our trials and sense some kind of familiarity to us. ...","These spirits attach themselves to us for a period of time when they feel that our fate corresponds with certain aspects of their own. I learned how to visualise those spirits and therefore can say a bit about the future that might await you. ...","Even more, I connected those spirits to a certain symbolism to make the concept more accessible. I learned that people that share the same symbols are somehow connected by fate. ...","We can use this fact to help the captain to find his crew. He needs people who are connected to each other to help him in his quest.","I am only known as Smaralda in these days.","My endeavours of the past are unimportant. I'm nothing but an old woman that sometimes dabbles with the mystic arts. ...","Now I'm just a fortuneteller and sometimes a helper of fate. And I know a few old stories.","I rarely use my gift in these days. I use it only to help the old pirate to find the rest that he deserves by finding a crew for his ship.","Of all stories that I could tell, there is only one that is of importance in these days. This is the story about the old pirate.","Now that you have captured enough of the spectral scum you may use my crystal ball to meet the captain. ...","But keep in mind that you need three others with the same soul mark to proceed.","This world was successful in xx journeys. 50 journeys are necessary to give the captain some peace for this month.","Good bye, Jogador."]}

Thought so.","I do not have a proper name, for I am a child of nature. I was given the gift to communicate with ancient ethereal beings; that is where my name comes from: the 'Spirit Speaker'.","The gift that has been bestowed upon me is the ability to communicate with the spirits and other ethereal entities who are among us. ...","It helps me uncover important knowledge about our surroundings. Knowledge I then share with the people who visit this place to inspire them to explore the wonders this world has to offer.","Job? I am a spirit speaker and a traveller of these lands. I discover its mysteries and learn about its past... our past. ...","Now you may be wondering what I do with all that knowledge and the answer is simple - I share it.","Mysteries! This world is full of them; take for instance the mysterious creature who lurks in the jungles of Port Hope which is said to carry one of the rarest plants known to botany! ...","Or the tales of underwater kingdoms ruled by fish-like creatures. Welcome! You can ask me about your 'trust points'!","I am the shaman of Rascacoon.","I'm the diviner of the will of the great raccoon and keeper of wisdom.","This colony lived in peace for centuries, but this peace is now severely disrupted. The pirats became a constant threat and annoyance.","This colony is called Rascacoon. But our tribe originates from a far way rascoohan city with the name Washingstone.","When they were still known as Corym, there were only occasional clashes over loot and flotsam. But one day things changed.","It's only a place of mystery and legend. We have no contact since generations and its location was lost in time.","Our spies found out that the Corym retrieved an ancient book from a trunk in a shipwreck. It taught them about the ways of the pirates.","Their leaders were convinced that this was a description of the old and forgotten ways of their people and they adopted it.","They became the pirats that we know today. They became more organized and more aggressive.","Things escalated when they by chance discovered the explosiveness of the mold of one of their favourite cheeses.","They weaponized the mold and refined it to so called green powder to create devastating weapons.","For now they employ it to terrorize the seas and experiment with its power.","It's only a matter of time until they will come and use their weapons against us. Therefore they have to be stopped.","I fear they have yet to unleash the true destructive power of this weapon. For all what we know they keep experimenting and refining it, somewhere deep in their dens. ...","To disrupt those experiments might prove helpful.","We know many secrets and studied the pirats for a long time. Our knowledge will prove helpful in fighting them.","Before we share our knowledge you have to help us, to strengthen our position and secure our colony.","When we feel safe enough from their retribution, we can approve a strike to the heart of the pirats. Until then it will be your mission to assist our colony.","He is our creator and guide.","The mother of all gave birth to the gods. The gods immediately begun with the creation of the world, as this was their only purpose.","Their greatest accomplishment was the creation of the great raccoon. Of all of the gods creations only he was perfect and therefore he was unique.","But the great raccoon immediately felt an enormous loneliness, because all of creation had their peers to bond but the unique raccoon hadn't.","So after the gods were done with creation, the great raccoon stole the secret of life out of their trashcan and created us Rascoohans in his image.","The great raccoon looks over us and we live our life to his enjoyment.","When the gods moved on to create other world, the great raccoon stood behind and kept watching over us.","What king? We have no king or leader. We have to convince other to cooperate and don't order them.","Are you sure that you want to listen to rascoohan wisdom? It might shatter the perception of reality for the weak.","Fools rush in while the iron is still hot.","It's better to be poor and healthy than to throw stones from inside a glasshouse.","If a man fools you once, shame on him. But if you teach him how to fish, he'll probably won't bother you ever again.","Never pass on a free snack or an unsecured trashcan - which is basically the same.","Too many cooks are better than one.","The early bird gets the worm. But the worm got up even more early and what good did it do him?"]}

greet: GET ME OUT OF HERE! NOW!

reply: I am a great and famous actor! Not a princess, at all. I was only PRETENDING to be a princess. But try explaining that to those stupid pirates.
Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
Stage acting was a waste of my immense talent. Not only am I a born leader, my talent is more profitable when it is used for conning people.
He was always a fool with a heart too soft to become a feared pirate.
Me playing a princess was just part of a cunning plan we had.
If you find some way to release me I might even let you live as reward! So you'd better do your best or I'll kill you!
How dare you? I left to rot in this dirty cell and you have nothing better to do than chit chat?
YOU .. YOU .. You are as good as dead! I will get you! Do you hear me? I will have your head! On a platter!
In a just world, I would be captain of a grand ship, ...
Those pirates out there would now be my minions, and we would brave the seas and become the terror of the coastal towns! ...
If only our plan had worked!
Captain Kid sold his ship to buy pointless things like those insanely expensive locks for the cell doors. ...
He said the canoes would do for a while. ...
I got the impression he was not overly sad to part with the ship because he was known to suffer a lot from seasickness.
I'd have been a much better captain then Kid was. I played several captains on stage and I was good! ...
Where Kid longed for the appreciation of his men, I would rule by fear and with an iron fist!
It was all captain Kid's idea. You see, he hated his name and planned to become known by the name captain Kidnap. ...
All he needed was someone famous to kidnap. ...
Given his men's dismal lack of talent and intelligence that would have been quite a feat. ...
We knew each other from a few scams we did together in the past, so he contacted me. ...
I was to impersonate the famous Princess Lumelia. You know, the one everyone was looking for. ...
That would show his men and the other pirates what a great kidnapper he was. ...
He promised me that I would become his second in command and lead a wonderful life of plundering, robbing and pillaging. ...
So I agreed to impersonate the Princess for a while and it worked fine at first. ...
He returned with me dressed as the Princess from a raid on his own and was instantaneously the hero of the day for his men. ...
Things went bad when they decided to have a victory party. ...
As far as I could make out from the mumblings of the pirates, Kid lost the key to my cell while relieving himself in the underground river. ...
The fool decided to dive after it .. never to be seen again. ...
When I found out about Kid's demise I tried to convince the pirates it was a hoax, but they just won't believe me!
Ah kidnapping is so much fun. That is, if you're not on the receiving end. ...
It's easy money and you have a chance to frighten and torture someone who can't fight back!
The more stupid the people are, the easier it is to con them. ...
And the poorer they are the less means they have to get revenge. Har Har! ...
So I make sure I ruin those I scam. Then they have other things to worry about than getting revenge on me.
The key was lost in the underground river and has probably washed into the seven seas by now! ...
If that stupid Kid hadn't been so obsessed with kidnapping he'd not have sold his ship to buy the most expensive and complicated locks for his cells!
As long as we stick to undefended coastal towns we can make an easy fortune. Har Har! ...
As soon as I get out of here I'll finally become a pirate captain on my own. I don't need Captain Kid!

entries.text: I am a MAN! Get me out you drunken fools!
Get me out! It was all part of the plan, you fools!
If I ever get out of here, I'll kill you all! All of you!
I am NOT Princess Lumelia, you fools!
Get a locksmith and free me or you will regret it, you foolish pirates!
I am not a princess, I am an actor!

greet: So you have come, |PLAYERNAME|. I hoped you would not...
Hi! What is it, what d'ye {want}?
Hello. I am a blue stone.

reply: I am known as a blue stone.
My role here is decoration exchange contact.

reply: ........ ... Ri..... ... Ritual didn't work. RIBBIT?! I can speak the human language again! Ribbit! Well, at least sometimes it seems. Ribbit. And who the heck are you??
I don't want to be an assistant anymore. Ribbit. I just want my dream pond.
That old fool! He should be locked up with his weird theories and ideas and forced to study some serious magic! Rrrribbit!
Ribbit?!
Are you? I see. I saw you poking around here earlier. Ribbit. Well whatever you were trying to do, I'm not sure it was successful. Ribbit. What was that princess thing all about, anyway??
Yep, he told me one day that that was his name. In the tone of voice that makes your ears almost explode and singes your hair.
You know... being a frog isn't that bad. Ribbit. I don't want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond.
Magic, pah. Ribbit. I don't need magic. I just want some flies, actually. Ribbit.
That demon is called ribbit. Erm, no, I mean Samael. He is one REALLY annoyed demon overlord, but we get along okay. Not sure if I'd let him out of there though. Ribbit.
Well... ribbit... my name is Turian. But that doesn't really matter anymore.
You know... being a frog isn't that bad. Ribbit. I don't want to be a human again. I just wish I could get out of this cage and live by a lovely little pond.
I like the pond north of Thais. It's a really cosy place. Not just for humans, but especially for frogs. Ribbit.
I used to be Eclesius' assistant! Argh! Then - ribbit - one of his crazy experimental spells backfired and hit me. That's when I lost my job I guess. Ribbit.

greet: Ohh...
Chhchh?
send_trade: Chchch. Chh! <you're not sure, but it seems that squirrel wants to trade your valuable acorns for useless stones that it found and considered uneatable>

reply: Chh? Chhh?? <though you don't understand squirrelish, that one seems really excited>
Chhhhhhhhhhh!

greet: *sigh* Yet another dumb adventurer.
farewell: Yeah, good bye and don't come again!

reply: If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
If another prince comes to kiss me, I'll kick his ass so bad that he'll need a sedan chair to get away.
Don't even try to kiss me or I'll rondhouse kick you!
Talking frogs don't exist, idiot. It's your fucking imagination tricking you. And now your imagination commands you to walk away.
Finally someone notices I'm a FROG. Congratulations, you're VERY observant... *sigh*
A quest? Yeah I got a quest! Go and tell King Tibianus his son tried to kiss me again!
Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.
Pyrale? That idiot transformed me into an human once. But my wife came and kissed me, so I'm a frog again.

greet: Ah, I feel a mortal walks these ancient halls again. Pardon me, I barely notice you. I am so lost in my thoughts.

reply: You will now be travelled out of here. Are you sure that you want to face that teleport?
Then stay here in these ghostly halls.
I can offer you a {teleport}.
Dont mind me.

greet: I feel you. I hear your thoughts. You are ... alive.

reply: Once I was a member of the order of the nightmare knights. Now I am but a shadow who walks these cold halls.
The north has a puzzle to complete.

greet: Interesting. A human who can speak the language of wolves.
Huh? What? I can see! Wow! A non-mino. Did they {capture} you as well?
farewell: Good bye! Don't forget about the secrets of mathemagics.
walkaway: Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.

reply: No! I won't tell you. Shame coz it would be useful for you - hehehe.
It's easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn't it?
Hey! That's me! You got it! Thanks mate - now I remember my name!
I am the mightiest sorcerer from here to there! Yeah!
Yes, they capture people. I guess that's their job.
He is the worst of them all! He is the king of the minos! May he burn in hell!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
How could I escape? They only give me rotten food here. I can't regain my powers because I have no mana!
He is the leader of the outcasts. I hope he will never conquer the city of Mintwallin. That would be the end of me!
Wait! Don't leave! I want to tell you about my surreal numbers.
Power. Hmmm. Once while we were crossing the mountains together a man named Aureus said to me that parcels are equal to power. Any idea what that meant?
I have many books in my home. But only powerful people can read them. I bet you will only see three dots after the headline! Hehehe! Hahaha! Excellent!
The only monster I cannot conjure. But soon I will be powerful enough!
My name is - uhm - hang on? I knew it yesterday, didn't I? Doesn't matter!
Better save time than comitting a crime. I am a poet and I know it!
They are trying to capture me! Or hang on! Haven't they already captured me? Hmmm - I will have to think about this.
Tataah!
Yeah! There are many monsters guarding my home. Only the bravest hero will be able to slay them!
Job? JOB? Hey man - I am in prison! But you know - once upon a time - I was a powerful mage! A mage ... come to think of it .., what is that - a mage?
Sure I have the key! Hehehe! Perhaps I will give it to you. IF you can solve my riddle.
It's easy to find your way through it! Just follow the pools of mud. Hehe - useful hint, isn't it?

greet: Hu-man! Eek! Go away!

reply: Oh, kind hu-man asks for goblin name! But too dangerous, am sought goblin! Ogres must not know!
Am, er, purveyor of things! Yes! Bring stuff where needed, discreetly-like! Heheh!
Urgh, ogre smell baaad! Like rotten rat cheese and dragon eggs! Terrible day for goblins when ogres found us! Slavery, sadness, sorrow!

greet: Hi? What do you mean 'hi' - can't you see I am a... I have to lower my voice. Did it occur to you, that this 'chalice' does not want to be disturbed?! Leave me alone!

reply: 'Alice the chalice'... Hmpf, of course I won't TELL you my name, I am UNDERCOVER! Now be quiet or they will hear you.
Well, I am drinking most of the time. Er, no I mean - trying to hold my fluids... ah, wait that came out wrong: I am doing research. Let's just keep it at that.
