greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Who are you? What do you want? You seem too experienced to become my assistant. Please leave.

reply: He was bested in combat, but the hero who killed him, was that humble that he never claimed the fame.
As my assistant you can carry out daily tasks and solve missions for me.
Yes?
What's wrong? Are you afraid to go down there? There's absolutely no reason for that. Me? Erm... my knees, you know. Stairs are such a trial for me. Go on! Secure the cage and calm the demon!
Oh dear. It's all my fault that he is the way he is now. That much I can remember. <sniff>
It's to the far east of here. You can either reach it by ship or walk there, but it's QUITE a walk. I think.
Was that your name...? |PLAYERNAME|? Really? <scratches head> Fine then... hello |PLAYERNAME|!
Yes, you SHOULD be sorry!
I moved away from there for a reason. I just can't remember what the reason was.
What are you thanking me for? <scratches head>
My name is Eclesius. And I'm quite happy that my memory works almost all of the time.
Oh dear. It's all my fault that he is the way he is now. That much I can remember. <sniff>
Hint? What kind of hint?

I have a lot of work to do. I'm a very wise sorcerer, you see. So I'm busy creating magic fields, inventing new spells, reading books, summoning creatures... all very complex. That's why I need assistants for the easy work.
Where did I put that key, erm... I think it's somewhere in my lab. But then again my memory is not the best.

entries.text: I'm looking for a new assistant!
Err, what was it again that I wanted...?
Do come in! Mind the step of the magical door, though.
I'm so sorry... I promise it won't happen again. Problem is, I can't remember where I made the error...
Actually, I STILL prefer inexperienced assistants. They're easier to keep an eye on and don't tend to backstab you.
So much to do, so much to do... uh... where should I start?

reply: Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |BLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Hello |PLAYERNAME|! Do you need some equipment for your house?
send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

reply: I have {beds}, {chairs}, {containers}, {decoration}, {flowers}, {instruments}, {pillows}, {pottery}, {statues}, {tapestries} and {tables}. Which of those would you like to see?
Fine.
My name is Eddy. I sell furniture.
You mean my specials, don't you?
I have beds, chairs, containers, decoration, flowers, instruments, pillows, pottery, statues, tapestries and tables. Which of those would you like to see?
Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

entries.text: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

greet: This world is nothing without poetry, don't you think? It gives us hope, it envokes love. It's inciting and invigorating all the same.

reply: Our world, our home, our very own plane of existence. We have to protect it, mind you. Underneath all the battles, challenges and monsters there still resides a majestic, yet vulnerable being. A mother to us all.
A king and a beggar know more than a king alone... ahem, except for King Tibianus. He most certainly would. All hail King Tibianus etc. etc.
So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
So, you're on a mission. Aren't we all? A quest to savour the important moments, the valuable memories? To fight for love and happiness, heroically and against all odds? Yes, we are indeed.
Rather a calling. The weight of words is something not easily lifted by some, yet it can be a mighty weapon to others. ...

entries.text: Orshabaal was out of his maze to make us suffer for many days. In Calmera, a knight with blue beard from his hideout appeared. He fought bravely supported by mages, the demon ran and is gone for ages.

A knight from Guardia needed Chayenne's key. His friend dropped the item on the floor, hoping no one would see. But, at the same moment, a man crossed their way and all the knight's dreams faded away.
A knight from Candia was dining at Frodo's hut, devouring plates full of meat and whatnot. Suddenly, he was called to fight. He wanted to put his armor on but it was too tight.
The druid entered a Premian pyramid intent on the kill, 'Oh, that djinn will die, it will!' Down and up the stairs she hopped like a cat... When, Oops! She moved the wrong way, and died a drunk rat.
Hoping to find a strange orc in his spawn, a Zaneran knight logged on before dawn. A sudden heart attack left him surprised as Sam's old backpack he had recognised.
The world I shall save', an Olympian knight proclaimed! But from a visit to the bar he could not abstain! He woke up in pain, it all was in vain. From Venorian beer he will forever refrain.
During the dark and scary night, when others sleep he goes to fight, banishing demons, that feels right, purging the evil on the sight, fearlessly waiting for daylight, Zeluna's bravest elite knight.
A druid from Celesta once talked with a girl, he even bought her a necklace with a huge white pearl. Every time he went home, without money and fame, I guess this girl is cursed, Aruda is the name.

A story of a knight untold, on Rowana the dice she rolled. She lured players from afar. Who could resist a shining star? She promised gold and many items, then stole their heart with cunning kindness.
Do you think it's just a game? Don't you fear the dragon's flame? If you are as brave as bright, if you do not stray from fight, you may want to hear tonight, the tale of Guardia's lonely knight.
For a knight from Yanara 10,000 gold were a lot. So he ventured with a team into the desert to win that pot. He solved all the riddles, strongly willed. But on his journey home he sadly was killed.
A great mage from Celesta went dungeon down deep, he was very brave but his wand was cheap. Among white skeletons one of them was red. Last what he saw were the words: 'You are dead!'
A young sorcerer born and raised on Astera when dragons were scary, it was that kind of era. Walking all the way to the city of Venore, he stole from the dwarven bridge nothing less than an iron ore.
A druid from Eternia just bought his first boots of haste, to finally have his leather boots replaced. Catching a backpack of fish was now his dream, but he ended up swinging his new boots upstream.
A sorcerer from Efidia took his horse and got it saddled, and set out for battle. His horse lost control and threw him into a hole. Now his team lost all hope, because he forgot to bring a rope.
A knight in Guardia was feeling bored. He wanted to show a dragon lord the taste of his new carlin sword. To its lair then he did go. But before he saw his foe, he met his end by a one hit K.O.
On Secura a confident knight levelled to main, 840 rats he had slain. 'I am going to kill dragons,' he said while pounding his breastplate. The next thing he saw was: 'You have met a sad fate.'
One morning frosty fresh and nice, a knight was fishing on the ice. Catching some pikes for soup, but a dire penguin ate his loot. His angry wife said in the house: Now whole Beneva will laugh at us!
A paladin slaying dragons on Antica's soil, when a lord charges on to make the adventurer's blood boil. It puts up a strong fight, but to no avail. It gets slain and drops a dragon scale mail!
Through Rookgaard's sewer there swarmed no fewer than a hundred screeching rats. Wading through mud, and covered in blood, two young men fought back-to-back. To Trimera's end; a knight, and a friend.

greet: Oh, hello |PLAYERNAME|! How nice of you to visit an old man like me.
farewell: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.
walkaway: Come back whenever you're in need of wisdom.

reply: I gather wisdom and knowledge. I am also an astrologer.
This brotherhood was an secret society of necromancers and followers of purest evil. They were vanquished long ago by their arch enemies, the Nightmare Knights.

The Triangle of Terror is a cabal of three archdemons that have put aside their quarrels to establish some power in the shadows of the Ruthless Seven. Although they are all very mighty demons, compared to one of the seven, they appear weak ... So they try not to interfere much with the doings of the seven and look for power elsewhere. Their members are Morgaroth, the schemer, Ghazbaran, the lord of blades and Zoralurk, the demon with the thousand faces.
The Nightmare Knights were an ancient order dedicated to fight evil. They were guided by prophetic dreams. The order ceased to exist after their war against the Brotherhood of Bones.
Though they possess only a few charges, stone skin amulets are sought after because they offer complete protection from physical damage.
Although some priests claim that a war was fought on behalf of the gods, it seems more likely that this was kind of a civil war between the Djinn of good and the Djinn of evil.
There is no such thing, believe me. The dead don't care for taste.
These amulets are a more powerful version of the elven amulets. They were created by a race long gone from this plane, and offer significant protection against every kind of damage.
These amulets protect you against harm from energy attacks and magic fields.

This chalice was a tool of the gods which they created to make their task to create life easier. Zathroth who lacked the knowledge of creation stole that chalice and used it to spawn his evil minions.

The overlords of the demonkind are more powerful than even demonlords are. They are nearly indestructible. Armoured with layers of impenetrable hide and endowed with awesome magical power, demon overlords are true incarnation of death.
An infernal place in which the nightmare knights created a base to fight the minions of evil. It was lost when the Ruthless Seven conquered it.
Somewhere in the Plains of Havoc, where the Necromant King was defeated, lies the secret entrance to the Pits of Inferno.
The core piece of these amulets is a little dragon scale. It protects you to some extent against fire damage.
This charm, feared and despised by the undead, protects your lifeforce from life-draining powers.
These powerful amulets are usually blessed by some god. They offer additional armour and protection.
This ring increases the rate with which you heal your physical wounds.
They are more than a myth, they are a horrible reality. It is possible that they still reside in the pits of inferno.
These amulets were created and enchanted by powerful magicians and priests. They protect both body and soul from the losses caused by the trauma of death.

The so-called singing steel causes a constant humming while it is forged. It is said this was a sign of its absorbing magic powers in the process, and it was presumably easy to enchant. ... Sadly, the secret where to mine or how to create this ore has been lost in the course of time.
The Paradox Tower was home of a mighty but mad wizard. It is said that only the cunning and mad can brave the tests of that tower to gain its treasures.
This human showed no fear and did not yield under torture. They could bend him, but they never managed to break him. Impressed by this mortal, Gabel talked to him and learned about his philosophy.

The legendary banshee queen is incredibly old and likely next to invincible. She's rumoured to have her lair in the deepest caverns of the ghostlands. She seems to be more likely to talk than her sisters, but is certainly even more evil than them.
Behind the mountain lies a land of great danger.
Some creatures are able to attack your magic power rather than your lifeforce. This amulet bestows some protection against those attacks.
This amulet purifies your blood. It will reduce the damage caused by poison.

The Djinn were the result of his first attempts. They were powerful and quite evil, but not as evil as Zathroth wished and quite independent in their thinking. Finally he discarded them and decided his second try would become his masterpiece.
A shame he's gone. He could have become somewhat of a tourist magnet.
These ancient elven artefacts are highly enchanted and grant some protection against any form of damage.
This is the metal of 'evil', the hell-forged iron no ordinary flames can melt. It is rumoured to be harvested in hell from iron rocks in which damned souls were imprisoned.
I am fine, thank you.

Zathroth channelled all the hatred and foulness he could muster. He added the burning rage of his son Blog and mixed it with fire. The energy that was released destroyed the chalice, but Zathroth had succeeded in creating the first demon.
The gods created the vortex to guide powerful souls to our world so they might join the battle for creation.
Although lovely, the city of the elves lacks the grace and the vibrance of the elven cities of old. The elves are still working on improvement of their settlement.
The elves of Shadowthorn are hosile to intruders. Their Kuridai leaders practise some sinister cults and the other castes are more their minions then their equals.
Magic items are numerous. If you would like some details, please ask me about a specific item.
These rings were created by an ancient, long since forgotten race. It is said they valued secrecy above all. They used these magic rings to make themselves invisible.
There are several kinds of magic metals in our world, the best known are called Mesh Kaha Rogh, Za'Kalortith, Uth'Byth, Uth'Morc, Uth'Amon, Uth'Maer, Uth'Doon, and Zatragil.
The human whom the Djinn had caught was none other but Daraman. The mighty Gabel was intrigued by his philosophy and changed his ways according to Daraman's teachings.

The archdemons are few, and extremely rare. And a good thing, too, for they are the rulers of the demon race. They are vain and powerhungry creatures who tend to form only small cabals and fight each other instead of allying against creation.

The ancient structures that were found deep beneath the ghostlands were built by an unkown race for an unknown purpose. It's quite certain that, whatever they were once used for, they now cause madness and ghost sightings in the surrounding area.
The underground city of the minotaurs can be reached through a dangerous passage from the old temple.
In the old days the underground temple was built for the glory of Banor after a victory over the orcish hordes. It is now an abandoned and dreary place overrun by rotworms.
These rings were created by the sorcerers' guilds of old. They temporarily provide their wielders with a shield of magic.
Well, just ask me about anything that might be of interest. We will see if I can help you.

In the war of the Djinn citys were levelled, lands were cursed and islands sunk. Finally, Malor was caught and imprisoned in an enchanted bottle. His followers fled this plane, while the good djinn laid to rest to recover their strength.

The teachings of asceticism, inner peace and ascension appealed to the Djinn, although in the beginning this was probably only because of his vanity and his greed for divinity. However, Malor and his followers opposed him.

Morgaroth belongs to the cabal Triangle of Terror. He usually has minions to do his work rather than doing it himself. Although sometimes he enters our world in person to inspire the fear his cabal is built upon.
Ghazbaran is a member of the demonic cabal Triangle of Terror. He likes the physical challenge and combat as much as the pain and death he inflicts.

Orshabaal is one of the many servants of the Ruthless Seven. By far weaker than his masters, he seems to have developed some kind of inferiority complex which he tries to compensate by raiding our world and slaying as many innocents as he can.
How could they try to understand death, if they don't care to understand life?
The ancient fortress city of the dwarfs was carved into the mountain known as 'The Big Old One'. It is quite hidden and heavily guarded to withstand any assault.
It was on Rookgaard where the soul vortex appeared. The Thaian kingdom holds an outpost there to protect the vortex and to guide the newly-arrived souls.
This kind of ring will increase your skill when fighting with bare hands.
This ring will give you limited protection against any kind of damage.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding swords.
The ancient dwarven kings forged it using magic metal , which they took from cyclopses who found it in the heart of a fallen star.
Mages claim to be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
The town of Darashia is built around one of the few sweet water supplies of Darama. It is famous for its sand wasp honey and its sandworm stew.
Zoralurk is said to be a member of the demon cabal called Triangle of Terror. She is rumoured to wander the lands in many disguises, poisoning the body and minds of people by word or deed.
The Abdaisim are what humans would call 'independent elves'. They take shelter wherever they might find it, are wanderers and explorers. They only keep loose contact with the elven society.
One could call the Deraisim the scouts and rangers of elvenkind. Although all elves are formidable in that area, the Deraisim excel them all.

Zathroth is the dark twin of Uman. They are one and they are two separate entities. We mortals can't really grasp this concept. He is the patron of dark magic and even darker secrets, the lust for dominance through cunning, and manipulation.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding a club weapon.
These rings improve your regenerative powers, accelerating the recovery of both your mana and your lifeforce.
This steel absorbs magic. While it is of inferior quality compared to ordinary steel, its absorbing qualities make it important though.
What makes this black steel exceptional is its lightness and peculiar property of lacking the common steel 'noise'. It is also called 'silent steel' or 'thief's steel' for this reason.
The luminescent brightsteel is used for artwork mainly. In ancient times, items of great magic power were crafted using brightsteel. Those crafts were lost with the races who held the secret to them.
The dwarfs call it heartiron and claim it is part of the heart of The Big Old One. Therefore, they hold it sacred and its use is limited and regulated.
The dwarven high steel is relatively common but expensive and still hard to come by. The elite dwarven weaponry and armours are made of Uth'Doon.
The so-called dreamsilver is a legendary metal. Almost everything we know about it are rumours only.
A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.
As far as I can tell, this creature is not fond of cheaters and won't allow them to pass his tests.
Dungeons are a place of danger, not of joy. Keep that in mind on your travels.
Man or monster, the difference is often just a matter of hides and scales.

Daraman was a sage with ambition, that's for sure. His philosophy centred around the idea that by controlling yourself you could improve yourself. The closer you are coming to perfection, the closer you are to ascending to divinity.
The banshees are creatures that grief and despair turned into vengeful spirits after their death. Their wail is deadly, and they draw new strength from the pain and fear of others.
Endulos was not a great warrior, but a man of wit and genius. After many of his brethren of the Nightmare Knights had fallen prey to the beast, he came up with a cunning plan to end this threat.
The Necromant King. He is dead forever, and that is the nicest thing I can say about him. May he rot in his tomb.

The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.

The Kuridai are the craftsmen and warriors of elvenkind. They are always moving, always scheming. They are the most aggressive elves and distrust outsiders. An outsider might be each non-Kuridai to them.
Its said that those elves were the masters of the dreams. Which many consider a special brand of magic. They seem to have vanished from the face of Tibia ages ago, however, and their fate is unknown.

Cyclopses are seen as the smiths of Blog, whom they call 'the ragehammer' or 'ragehammerer'. Indeed their skills create mostly crude and nasty-looking weapons and armor, but which are incredibly effective nonetheless.
This ring will increase your skill when wielding any kind of axe.
That's me, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.
Rumours are an unsafe path to follow.
Rumours are an unsafe path to follow.
Those who live by the sword get shot by those who don't.
Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.
Knights could be artists, but tend to become sellswords.
Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.
Mages claim to be wise, but how wise can it be to sacrifice your life to books and scrolls and not for the people?
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
A strong wall may protect from an assault, but what will protect you from the enemy within?
The dreaded town of Drefia was once a haven for heretics, necromancers and demon worshippers. Its was destroyed in the war of the Djinn.
The desert lands of Darama are harsh and unforgiving. Therefore Daraman led his people there to found a new community based upon his teachings.
There are at least five demonic cabals of archdemons. The ruthless seven are the most prominent and powerful.
Whatever the original meaning of that underground complex was, it is now like an open wound in the nearby lands, spreading madness and attracting all kinds of ghosts and apparitions.

As far as we know, once a terrible beast roamed the lands we now call the Plains of Havoc. It was so fierce that no one dared to even dream about killing it. It was finally tricked by the knight Endulos.
A city in the far north. It separated itself from the Thaian kingdom about 100 years ago. Now it is ruled by a dynasty of queens.
Venore is a centre of commerce and trade. Its ambitious trade barons are nominally subjects of the Thaian kingdom.
The elven society is dividded into certain castes, the cenath, the kuridai, the deraisim, the abdaisim and the legendary teshial.
The Cenath favour magic above all other. They are the keepers of elven lore and wisdom. They are responsible for the astounding feats of druidic magic the elves are capable of.
I believe that true love is stronger than all magic, don't you agree?
A paladin is more than just a knight armed with a bow and some spells, though most seem to be unaware of that fact.
Druids seek enlightenment in nature, but they often just find what they brought with them.
Sewers are sometimes the safer ways to get where you want to go.

Legend has it that the Djinn were created by Zathroth by using the stolen chalice of life. They roamed the world for Aeons causing strife and despair until Gabel, one of their lords, met a very special human.

Malor was second in power only to Gabel and his followers among the Djinn were many. It was not easy for the evil Djinn to change their ways, and many preferred to follow Malor instead of Gabel. In the end a civil war erupted.
Gabel was the most powerful among the Djinn lords. He was cruel and merciless, until one day his minions brought a certain human to him whom they had captured and tortured.
Demons are the servants of evil. More or less devoted servers of Zathroth they cause strife and havoc wherever they appear. Their masters are known as Demonlords, Demon Overlords and Archdemons.
If Tibia is a fallen god, does that makes us the maggots crawling on it?
Edron is the latest colony of the Thaian kingdom. However, structures of an earlier colonisation have been found. We cannot tell if those inhabitants were human or of any other known race.
Thais is the capital of an ancient human kingdom. Once its rule was more or less undisputed. In the years the strength of the Thaian kingdom eroded by different events.

The small but strong dwarves are tireless workers and fierce warriors. They are familiar with several crafts and mastered most of them. In our days their smithing skills are rivalled only by those of the cyclopses.
I am Edowir, but don't worry about remembering my name. I will forget your name as well.
Time is a pillar and our lives wind around it like vines.
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
Who laughs last, thinks slowest.
Kings are children adorned with crowns.
I think you are referring to the beast Hugo that is said to still haunt the Plains of Havoc. The legends which tell of this creature are ancient and almost forgotten.
He lured Hugo into a trap. Bound by roots and stones charged with powerful magic he could not move anymore. Now, the beast lies trapped in a hidden cave for all eternity.
The legends tell us that the Nightmare Knights trapped it beneath one of their fortresses, or rather that they built a fortress on top of his eternal prison.

Uman is the light twin of Zathroth. Their unity and separation at once is a concept we cannot hope to grasp. He is the patron of light magic, the knowledge that benefits all and brings progress to the society.
Blog is the god of rage and fierce battle. He's also the patron of power, although a power to oppress and bully others around. He is the son of Zathroth and one of the Tibian suns.
Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.
Growing old is mandatory, growing up is optional.
Learn about the gods to learn from the gods.

entries.text: I'm just an old man, but I know a lot about Tibia.

greet: Welcome to Edron Furniture Store, |PLAYERNAME|.
send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain {type} of furniture?

reply: Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.

entries.text: Have you moved to a new home? I'm the specialist for equipping it.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Welcome to the paladins' guild, |PLAYERNAME|! How can I help you?

reply: Would you like to learn {conjure explosive arrow} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {conjure arrow} magic spell for 450 gold?
Would you like to learn {Destroy Field} Rune spell for 700 gold?
Would you like to learn {divine healing} magic spell for 3000 gold?
Would you like to learn {great light} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {intense healing} magic spell for 350 gold?
Would you like to learn {lesser ethereal spear} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {light healing} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {magic patch} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {arrow call} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {find fiend} magic spell for 1000 gold?
Would you like to learn {find person} magic spell for 80 gold?
Would you like to learn {light} magic spell for free?
I can teach you {attack} spells, {healing} spells, {support} spells and spells for {runes}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn? I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
My attack spells is: {Lesser Ethereal Spear}.
My healing spells are: {Cure Poison}, {Divine Healing}, {Intense Healing}, {Light Healing} and {Magic Patch}.
My support spells are: {Arrow Call}, {Conjure Arrow}, {Conjure Explosive Arrow}, {Find Fiend}, {Find Person}, {Great Light} and {Light}.
My rune spells are: {Destroy Field} Rune.
For level 35 I have {Divine Healing} for 3000 gold.
For level 25 I have {Conjure Explosive Arrow} for 1000 gold and {Find Fiend} for 1000 gold.
For level 20 I have {Intense Healing} for 350 gold.
For level 17 I have {Destroy Field} Rune for 700 gold.
For level 13 I have {Conjure Arrow} for 450 gold and {Great Light} for 500 gold.
For level 10 I have {Cure Poison} for 150 gold.
For level 8 I have {Find Person} for 80 gold, {Light} for free and {Light Healing} for free.
For level 1 I have {Arrow Call} for free, {Lesser Ethereal Spear} for free and {Magic Patch} for free.
I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
I am the leader of the Paladins. I help our members.
Paladins are great warriors and magicians. Besides that we are excellent missile fighters. Many people in Tibia want to join us.
Of course, we aren't as strong as knights, but no druid or sorcerer will ever defeat a paladin with a sword.
There are many magic spells and runes paladins can use.
Paladins are the best missile fighters in Tibia!
I am a paladin, not a storyteller.
Every paladin profits from his vocation. It has many advantages to be a paladin.
We will help you to improve your skills. Besides I offer spells for paladins.
Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
Some paladins serve in the kings army.
He has some potential.
How spineless do you have to be to become a jester?
The McRonalds are simple farmers.
He must have been skilled before he became the way he is now. Such a pity.
Yes?
The alcohol he sells shrouds the mind and the eye.
One of the most important members of our guild. She makes all the bows and arrows we need.
He sells a lot of useful equipment.
He and his guildfellows lack the grace of a true warrior.
A fine warrior and a skilled general.
King Tibianus is a wise ruler.
A follower of evil that will get what he deserves one day.
Mhm, a little too nice for my taste. Still, it's amazing how she endures all those men stalking her, especially this creepy Oswald.
A skilled healer, that's for sure.
Just another arrogant sorcerer.
If there wouldn't be higher powers to protect him...
A humble monk and a wise man.
Strong man. But a little shy.
So many claimed to have found and slain him but they had nothing to prove it.
Those are traditionally awarded after having completed a difficult task for our guild.
A weapon of myth. I don't believe that this weapon exists.
Someday I will slay that bastard!
Your vocation is your profession. There are four vocations in Tibia: Paladins, knights, sorcerers, and druids.
My name is Elane. I am the famous leader of the Paladins.
Oops. I have forgotten my watch.

greet: Be greeted |PLAYERNAME|. What is your {business} near the {hellgate}?

reply: I am the leader of the Kuridai and the Az'irel of Ab'Dendriel. Humans would call it {sheriff}, executioner, or avenger.
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
Sometimes people get imprisoned for some time. True criminals will be cast out and for committing the worst crimes offenders are thrown into the hellgate.
It was here among other structures, like the depot tower, before our people came here. It's secured by a sealed door.
For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
For safety we keep the door to the hellgate locked all times. I have the {keys} to open it when needed.
Not that I like to talk to you, but I am Elathriel Shadowslayer.
It's one of the more useful concepts we can learn from the other races.
It's hard for some of my people to grasp the true concept of a strong leader.
I mastered some battle spells.
I couldn't care less.
A human weakling, not much more.
A human weakling, not much more.
Druidic magic is too peaceful for my taste.
I have seen human sorcerers doing some impressive things ... before they died.
We might use the shelter earth and hills provide us, but their obsession for metal is a waste of time.
Like all inferior races, they can be at least of use for something good. The other castes are just jealous of us making use of them.
I still doubt it exists.
Even if he'd walk through the town above, the other castes would not see the necessity to follow OUR way.
My people are divided in castes in these times, until they comprehend that only the way of the Kuridai can save us all.
Arrogant bastards, but they wield quite powerful magic.
Dreamers are of no practical use. I don't mourn their demise.
Confused cowards. For all their skill, they still tend to hide and run. What a waste.
We are the heart of the elven society. We forge, we build, and we don't allow our people to be pushed around.
We watch this city and the actions of its inhabitants closely.
The merchants of venore provide us with some useful goods. Still I an convinced that they get more out of our bargain then we do.
The Thaian kingdom and we share some enemies, so it's only logical to cooperate in a few areas.
I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.
I offer hardly anything except for knowledge of {spells}.

greet: Be greeted. What brings you {here}?
Ashari |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: The elves of this city are the casts of the Cenath, the Kuridai, and the Deraisim.
I am a guardian of this town. I have no time to chat!
The Cenath are magic users. Look for them on the upper levels of the town.
The Deraisim are scouts and hunters. You may find them on the groundlevel of the city.
There are no Teshial.
If you are looking for that kind of equipment you should ask a Kuridai.
Ask around in Ab'Dendriel. Many elves can teach you something about magic. The Cenath love magic most of all.
The city of the humans lies somewhere far to the south beyond the mountains of the dwarfs.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Be greeted, |PLAYERNAME|. Which of my fine gems do you {need}?

reply: I am a jeweller. Maybe you want to have a look at my wonderful {offers}.
Well, I sell gems and {goblets}. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}.
Ah, our newest import! We have golden goblets, silver goblets and bronze goblets. All of them have space for a hand-written dedication.

greet: Welcome, |PLAYERNAME|. If you're interested in {spells} to support your party, I can be your teacher.

reply: Would you like to learn {enchant party} magic spell for 4000 gold?
Would you like to learn {heal party} magic spell for 4000 gold?
Would you like to learn {protect party} magic spell for 4000 gold?
Would you like to learn {train party} magic spell for 4000 gold?
I can teach you {support} spells. I can also tell you which spells are available at your {level}.
Support spells: {Enchant Party} (Sorcerer), {Heal Party} (Druid), {Protect Party} (Paladin), {Train Party} (Knight).
I have spells for level {32}.
For level 32 I have {Enchant Party} for 4000 gold, {Heal Party} for 4000 gold, {Protect Party} for 4000 gold and {Train Party} for 4000 gold.

greet: <nods>
Ashari |PLAYERNAME|.

reply: I sell musical instruments of many kinds.
I sell lyres, lutes, drums, and simple fanfares.
Music is an attempt to condensate emotions in harmonies and save them for the times to come.
Time has its own song. Close your eyes and listen to the symphony of the seasons.
Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
Everything is a song. Life, death, history ... everything. To listen to the song of something is the first step to understand it.
We are the most graceful of all races. We feel the music of the universe in our hearts and souls.
They could dig some halls for a big musical event, but they won't listen to me about that matter.
I bet they were great musicians.
That is some god the humans worship. Our pople are not interested in this gods anymore.
They are too loud and don't even understand the concept of a melody.
The other deraisim are too much concerned with mastering the nature so they don't listen to its music anymore.
The Cenath think they know the 'art' but the only true art is the music.
I went down to the mines and tried to lighten up their spirit, the foolish creatures did not listen to my songs, though.
Sorry, I don't feel like teaching magic today.

For the worst of crimes, criminals are cast into hellgate. It is said no one can return from there. Since it is not actually forbidden to enter hellgate, you might convince Elathriel to grant you entrance.

reply: My name is Emael.
My job is to showcase the trophies of slain monsters as aesthetical as possible. You can admire my work here in the Adventurers' Guild.

reply: I'm Emilie, proud representative of the Combined Magical Winterberry Society.
We agents of the Combined Magical Winterberry Society try to ensure the harvesting and processing of winterberries into all sorts of useful, magical fluids. ...
Winterberries are special berries only harvestable during a short time of the year. They are used to refine potions of all sorts. They can severely enhance their magical effects. ...
The Combined Magical Winterberry Society was founded more than one hundred years ago by mage Tolwyn Winter. ...

reply: I am privileged to be in service of our beloved queen!
We are proud people who fought hard for their freedom and won't allow others to oppress us again.
I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
The CGB is a patriotic organisation that fights our numerous enemies with means that guards or army do not have at their disposal. ...
We work secretly and covertly. We uncover secret plots and we are both the first line of defence of our city and the last. We are joined only by the best of the best.
The AVIN is rather a crime syndicate than anything else. If there is something dirty and illegal, they are most likely involved. ...
They are unscrupulous and also do not back away from blackmailing and assassination.
The TBI is as old-fashioned, stubborn and inflexible as only males can be. What makes this bureaucracy somewhat dangerous, is the money they have at their disposal. ...
They buy spies and traitors - all of them weak-willed or greedy individuals.
I am the head of Carlin's Girls Brigade, also known as CGB.
I am known as Emma.
The elves of Ab'Dendriel are our allies. Our druids contribute most to keeping such a good relation. ...
They seem to understand the elves a bit better than we ordinary people do.
The Thaians never got over the fact that we gained our independence. They do everything they can to hinder the prospering of our city.
Venore is a hellhole of evil. The trade barons' greed lets them plot against all other cities and even against each other.
Svargrond is an important project for our city. It's not a colony but many of our people live there alongside those barbarians. If everything works out fine, Carlin and Svargrond will both prosper.
Strange people with strange customs live in this city. Luckily, we rarely have to deal with them.
Darashia never bothers about the affairs of other cities.
The name of the city is a cruel joke. The people there are oppressed by Thais and Venore who slowly bleed the isle and its people white. ...
It shows what would have happened to us if our rebellion had failed.
It's just another Thaian puppet. Still, it is distant enough to stand a fair chance to get rid of Thais's oppression one day.
The dwarfs of Kazordoon usually mind their own business. I wish all other cities would do the same.
I can promote you for 20000 gold coins. Do you want me to promote you?
Alright then, come back when you are ready.

reply: I'm professor Falonzo from the mage's guild.
I'm a researcher of scientific council of the mage guild and I came to that {place} to study this {anomaly}.
This {plane} is now inhabited by {intruders} and creatures that accidentally became {dragged} in. ...
It is neither completely of our world nor is it still that disconnected and unreachable as it used to be. I fear it's only a harbinger of something more dangerous and more {sinister}.
Well, the whole place here is an anomaly so to say. You can hardly have missed the fact that you arrived here through a mystical gate. ...
Well actually it's no gate at all but a rift in the fabric of nature. It is this minor {plane} trying to reconnect to our world.

This is a lesser plane of tarnished, elemental fire that once belonged to the world that we know. It was despoiled in the wars of the gods and broke loose from our world. {Lost} and drifting through the void, without a connection to our plane.
Infernalists were the first who found their way into this sphere. Hoping to tap its rotten power somehow. Yet this sphere created creatures of its own and draw others here from other planes.
This place became a fiery trap to certain beings with an affinity to fire. Somehow it reconnects randomly with the known world, to which it once belonged ...
but also to other places that it shares some affinity with like hellish places of unspeakable evil that spawn infernal creatures.
Something is tearing at the fabric of reality. I can't tell what is it but the {boundaries} between worlds are fading. ...
A process that what watched for over a century but which has extremely grown in momentum over the last few years. Something is happening and it's for sure nothing good. ...
Be it as it may, the plane trying to reconnect was only a side effect. It still might teach us about what is happening and it has for sure attracted some {attention} already.

Well, that was how it used to be. Lost and without any connection to our world. But that was before things ... have {changed}.
We know about other planes of existence but in all history it has never been as easy to reach them as it is now. ...
Sometimes world seem to overlap and we can identify more and more such planes and worlds. More then we ever had imagined. All we can tell is, that something is changing. And not for the good.
Such an anomaly can't go unnoticed for long. That lead to the presence to unwanted {intruders} and other entities were {dragged} into by the nature of the sphere.

You shouldn't miss the experience.
You want me to transport you and your spouse back to {Fibula}?
You shouldn't miss the experience.

greet: Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free.
walkaway: Remember: If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can heal you for free.

reply: This is a special blessing I can bestow upon you once you have obtained at least one of the other blessings and which functions a bit differently. ...
It only works when you're killed by other adventurers, which means that at least half of the damage leading to your death was caused by others, not by monsters or the environment. ...

The {twist of fate} will not reduce the death penalty like the other blessings, but instead prevent you from losing your other blessings as well as the amulet of loss, should you wear one. It costs the same as the other blessings. ...
Would you like to receive that protection for a sacrifice of |PVPBLESSCOST| gold, child?

Whenever you receive a lethal wound, your vital force is damaged and there is a chance that you lose some of your equipment. With every single of the five {blessings} you have, this damage and chance of loss will be reduced.

There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.

greet: Yes? What may I do for you, |PLAYERNAME|? Bank business, perhaps?

entries.text: Don't forget to deposit your money here in the Global Bank before you head out for adventure.

greet: Good day, |PLAYERNAME|. I hope you bring a lot of {magical ingredients} with you.
farewell: Good bye and please come back soon.
walkaway: Good bye and please come back soon.
send_trade: Sure, take a look. Apart from those, I also buy some of the possessions from famous demonlords and bosses. Ask me about it if you found anything interesting.

reply: Oof, there are too many to list. Magical ingredients can sometimes be found when you defeat a monster, for example bat wings. I buy many of these things if you don't want to use them for quests, just ask me for a {trade}.

entries.text: The Edron academy is always in need of magical ingredients!

greet: Welcome to the Tibian bank, young adventurer! Deposit your gold or withdraw your money from your bank account. Remember to deposit all of your gold before you leave here. I can also explain the {functions} of your bank account to you.

reply: My name is Flavius, how may I assist you today?
Mhm?
I`m the banker here in Newhaven. It's my job to manage your bank account and change currencies. Though I may also help with questions you might have.
I'm just a banker, ask around maybe someone else could need your help.
She often travels to the mainland for supplies. I bet she can help you once you've reached level 8. You can find her at the ferry house just west of here.
Avriel runs a small shop here in the village. You can buy useful things for your adventures, but also sell things you might not need any longer. You will find his shop in the south of the village.
Ah, my good friend Gustavo, he's keeping us safe from the north part of this island. It can get pretty dangerous out there.
She's a well-read woman who knows a thing or two about magic. Maybe she can teach you a few spells. She might also have a small task for you. I've heard she's missing one of her books.
Isn't that the guard from Thais? I heard Gustavo talking about their ongoing friendship despite being apart.
Thais is our beautiful capital, ruled by our beloved king Tibianus III.
I heard the name refers to older times, where the economy was thriving much more than it does today.
If you enjoy the life outside of busy cities, you've come to the right place.
Our dearest King Tibianus, maybe someday I will be able to meet his highness. He resides at his castle in Thais.
Ever since the mining industry left our beautiful village, the mines have been haunted. I'd rather stay away from any kind of danger. But I heard Viola could need your help, adventurer.
You can deposit and withdraw money from your bank account here. I can also change money for you.

Every Tibian has a global bank account. This means you can deposit your gold in one bank, and withdraw it from the same or any other Tibian bank in any city. ... Here on Newhaven, I run the bank. I keep any gold you deposit safe, so you can't lose it when you're out fighting or dying, heh. Ask me for your {balance} to learn how much money you've already saved. ... There are also {advanced} functions, but those are only available to you once you have reached the Tibian mainland.
Your bank account will be used automatically when you want to rent a house or place an offer on an item on the market. Let me know if you want to know about how either one works.

Renting a house has never been this easy. Simply make a bid for an auction on the house section of the official Tibia website. We will check immediately if you have enough money ... Please keep in mind that the sum you have used to bid will be unavailable unless somebody places a higher bid. Once you have acquired a house the rent will be charged automatically from your bank account every month.

If you buy an item from the market, the required gold will be deducted from your bank account automatically. On the other hand, money you earn for selling items via the market will be added to your account. It's easy!

entries.text: Any questions about the functions of your bank account? Feel free to ask me for help!

reply: My name is Friedolin. Fun is what I love and orange what I represent!
I am a fan of Furb of Fun and I'm going to inform other Tibians about the BEST colour to join - orange of course!
Furb is the wizard of Fun. Pranks, jokes, funny things - he loves all of it. If you want to have some fun - it's the way to go.
Fern is the wizard of Nature. Behold his powers and the elemental might that is nature itself.

greet: Welcome to Frodo's Hut. You heard about the {news}?
farewell: Please come back from time to time.
walkaway: Please come back from time to time.

reply: I hope you like it. Would you like some {food}?
I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {selling} food.
I am the owner of this saloon. I call it Frodo's Hut. I am also {selling} food.
I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. If you'd like to see my offers, ask me for a trade.
Some travelers from Edron told about a great treasure guarded by cruel demons in the dungeons there.
Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
Oh, our beloved king! Thanks to him, alcohol is so cheap.
Harkath Bloodblade is the royal general.
Hehe. Great customers.
Just call me Frodo.
It is exactly |TIME|.
Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
Ah yes, the graveyard dungeon. All I know is this riddle: His Grave to the south, the tree above, his soul in the shade. No idea what that means, though!
I heard it when I was a child.
Yes, I remember him. His name was Berfasmur.
Sorry, he spoke only very little. I know nothing more about him.
Come on! You know that our world is called Tibia.
Nothing more than a tale for warriors.
Uhm, do not mention him. It may scare customers away.
No idea who that is, but maybe you'll find something in the Royal Archives...
Oh, the Royal Archives are in Rain Castle!
The king's residence has been renovated lately.
Many travellers tell funny stories about all the emancipated women in this northern town.
Here in Thais is the centre of Tibia.
He is a little shy. In his youth he dreamed to become a druid.
He's able to drink a bottle or two.
I am trying to hire him for an evening or two.
Oh, that old guy! He's a good customer, that's for sure.
Can you believe that she actually told her guildfellows that alcohol is a bad thing?
She makes excellent arrows and bows.
Many of his customers visit my Hut, too.
The knights have sometimes parties here after some arena fights.
Too disciplined to enjoy life.
I think some time ago a stranger from Fibula with that name stayed here for some nights.
I overheard some conversations about his evilness. That's enough to hope, that I never ever meet him.
A sorceress, you can find her in their guild sitting befor a book - always!
Just between you and me: What a babe! A shame that she is such a prude.
Marvik seldom leaves his guildhall at all.
The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
The McRonalds are a nice couple. Donald is a dear friend of mine.
Muriel has never visited this place.
I hate him. Each of his visits here ends with a bar brawl.
He hardly visits my humble tavern.
A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.
That fellow is filthy rich. He rented a room upstairs for months in advance and always orders the best beer and wine i serve.
I don't know where he gets these potions. If I could sell them here, the hut would be crowded.
That's horrible! I am in grief. I will never hear his songs again. I will even miss that strange rhyme he was obsessed with.
He is a great bard. He often graced my hut with his presence, songs, and rhymes. I wonder what happened to him lately.
I think the tales about him are widely exaggerated.
The sunset homes are a block of flats south of the harbour.
Hmm, I have heard of a 'satanic influence' theory by someone called Newton or something like that... Maybe there's more in the Royal Archives.
That would be my tavern of course... well and perhaps the royal satin that was created especially for the king but sometimes is bought by wealthy citizens as well.
A formula for a potion? No... he didn't talk to me about something like that.
Oh, by the gods! What do you say happened to him?
A formula for a potion? No... he didn't talk to me about something like that.
He recitated it that often that I learned it by heart myself. I would recitate it, but I am not skilled in that kind of things.
Well, some years ago, I would have asked you to talk with Lynda about this matter. However, since she became a priestess, she ... changed a lot.
Who he talked to? Hm... I'm not sure, there were a few people around. No girls or women though. Maybe just ask around for Eclesius.
A loud neighbour, I get a lot of complaints about him.

greet: No, you can't have my nose! If you're in need of a {carrot}, go to the market or just dig up one! Or did you come to bring me a {percht skull}?

reply: What about 'no' do you not understand, hrm? You are more annoying than any {percht} around here! Not to mention those bothersome {bunnies} who try to graw away my nose!
Well why didn't you say that rightaway, if you give me such a skull I can give you one of my {sleighs}.
Always trying to eat my nose!

farewell: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!
walkaway: Farewell, stranger. May Uman open your minds and your hearts to Daraman's wisdom!

greet: Hello. I am Gaberiel.

reply: I am known as Gaberiel.
My role here is Gift Giver.

greet: Oh, please come in, |PLAYERNAME|. What do you need? Distance weapons? I sell lots of them.

reply: If you'd ask me - what you just did - it's only a myth.
I don't buy used crossbows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.
I am the local fletcher. I am selling bows, crossbows, and ammunition. Do you need anything?
I heard about him.
We are feared warriors and good marksmen. Ask Elane if want to know more about the guild.
Tibia, a green island. Here it is wunderful to walk into the forests and to hunt with a bow.
I sell arrows for bows and bolts for crossbows. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
She is the leader of all paladins.
Tibia, a green island. Here it is wunderful to walk into the forests and to hunt with a bow.
We have visitors of all kind in Thais, only elves show up seldom.
It is rumored that they live in the northeast of Tibia. They are the best in archery.
I sell arrows for bows and bolts for crossbows. Ask me for a trade if you're interested to see my wares.
I am Galuna, paladin and fletcher.
Don't bother me. Go and buy a watch.
I supplied him with my goods in the past, now I sell them myself.
I don't buy used bows. If you want to buy one, just ask me for a trade.
I am the local fletcher. I am selling bows, crossbows, and ammunition. Do you need anything?
It is rumored that they live in the northeast of Tibia. They are the best in archery.

entries.text: Bows, crossbows and ammunition on special sale today.

farewell: Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.
walkaway: Bye. Tell others about... my little shop here.

reply: My grandfather had seen it with his own eyes!
So, you are a new recruit in the ranks of the rebellion! To proof your worthyness, go and get us a magic crystal.
Shhh! That's of no concern to me.
Oh, you know my name. Please don't tell it to the others.
Names don't matter.
I am selling some... things.

greet: Nice to meet you, Mister |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for furniture? You've come to the right place!
farewell: You'll come back. They all do.
send_trade: Have a look. Most furniture comes in handy kits. Just use them in your house to assemble the furniture. Do you want to see only a certain type of furniture?

reply: A thaian folklore tale.
You can't get any better wood in this world. And it has got a nice smell to it, too. There is nothing nicer than a marsh willow campfire.
Excellent! Never felt better in my life!
Now those people really talk business. There is a new era dawning.
Well - a few paranoid souls think that Venore wants to gain independence from Thais. Nothing more than rumours.
He's incredibly slow. Just your average postman, I guess.
Look! They are doing it again! And they are always smiling!
Ecle- who? No... can't say I know him.
That old monk has probably never left that overcrowded town here.
Yes! Smiling! How a professional sales artist such as myself is supposed to work in such an atmosphere is beyond me!
Our furniture is produced by the finest carpenters on the continent using the rare wood of the Venorean marsh willow!
The place where it all happens. That town really rocks! Thais could learn a lot about interior decoration from Venore!
I've said it a thousand times! That place needs a complete refurbishing!
Druids are obsessed with trees and the bane of any carpenter.
Those knights know how to party. And after such parties there's always need for new furniture.
The sorcerers guild could really need someone with taste to redecorate it.
Yes! I can never figure out which is which. And they are always watching me!
Yes! Selling is a form of art! The elaborate combination of rhetoric and acting which serves to create a sublime longing for the infinite, embodied by second class furniture.
Thais is obsessed with its past. Everybody here is so proud of their history. Bah! Thais might have a long history, but it has no idea when it comes to interior decoration.
Tibia is a wonderful place full of business opportunities.
She's pretty, but I am the kind of man who enjoys a long and healthy life.
Now those people really talk business. There is a new era dawning.
There are a few rumours about a rebellion, but that is all they are.
My friends call me Gamon. My fans call me the incredible Gammy!
Any time's a good time to buy some furniture.
I am Thais's foremost furniture salesman. Are you interested in my offers?
His Royal Highness will start to appreciate the superior quality of our stock soon enough!
He sells stuff of inferior quality. Nothing compared to venores high quality goods.
Bozo! Damn that clown! He keeps making fake orders. It isn't funny to deliver a wardrobe to an address that doesn't even exist, you know!
I am Thais's foremost furniture salesman. Are you interested in my offers?
I heard rumours he has some special offers for customers who know to ask for the correct things.
Oh, silly me! Rugs are out of stock at the moment! But we expect a new shipment anytime. Just watch out for the next update!... Of our inventory I mean.
Ah, those twins. Strange people they are. Oh, they are great to work with, of course. Excellent quality, competetive prices! But well... they give me the creeps!
Ah, those twins. Strange people they are. Oh, they are great to work with, of course. Excellent quality, competetive prices! But well... they give me the creeps!
Ah, those twins. Strange people they are. Oh, they are great to work with, of course. Excellent quality, competetive prices! But well... they give me the creeps!

entries.text: Any time's a good time to buy some furniture!

greet: Welcome, child. Have you come to learn about {magic}? Then you are in the right place. I can teach you many useful {spells}.
farewell: Go and be careful. Remember what you have learned!

reply: Would you like to learn {light magic missile} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {apprentice's strike} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {physical strike} magic spell for 800?
Would you like to learn {death strike} magic spell for 800 gold?
Would you like to learn {energy strike} magic spell for 800 gold?
Would you like to learn {terra strike} magic spell for 800 gold?
Would you like to learn {flame strike} magic spell for 800 gold?
Would you like to learn {ice strike} magic spell for 800 gold?
Would you like to learn {poison field} magic spell for 300 gold?
Would you like to learn {fire field} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {energy field} magic spell for 700 gold?
Would you like to learn {ice wave} magic spell for 850 gold?
Would you like to learn {cure poison} magic spell for 150 gold?
Would you like to learn {magic rope} magic spell for 200 gold?
Would you like to learn {find person} magic spell for 80 gold?
Would you like to learn {great light} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {light healing} magic spell for free?
Would you like to learn {levitate} magic spell for 500 gold?
Would you like to learn {haste} magic spell for 600 gold?
Would you like to learn {light} magic spell for free?
In this category I have '{light healing}' and '{cure poison}'.
In this category I have '{find person}', '{magic rope}', '{levitate}', '{light}', '{great light}', '{haste}', '{poison field}', '{fire field}', '{light magic missile}' and '{energy field}'.
In this category I have '{death strike}', '{apprentice's strike}', '{energy strike}', '{terra strike}', '{flame strike}', '{ice strike}', '{physical strike}', '{ice wave}'.
I can teach you {healing spells}, {support spells} and {attack spells}. What kind of spell do you wish to learn?
I am Garamond Starstream.
Did you not listen? I am the teacher of druid and sorcerer spells for level 8 to 18. I teach young adventurers spells they can use once they have the proper vocation - druid or sorcerer.
I have an old friend there. Haven't heard from him in a while.
Oh, it's not too bad here, believe me. At least I always get young and enthusiast disciples! Though I must confess I miss the vastness of the Tibian plains. <sighs>
A kind old hunter. He loves to see young life around, taking on the ways and lays of the land. If you have any question, ask Inigo for help.
Roughened and toughened by life's tragedies. A good man, but somber.
Yes, child. If you wish to learn a spell, tell me.
A very headstrong young man, though I appreciate his devotion to the craft of potion-making. No respect for senior authority or age at all! Except maybe for a little soft spot for Mr Morris.
A strange young man. He seems driven, to my mind. By what force, I do not know. I take it the world needs adventurers such as him.
Redeeming one's soul by becoming a clerk? Not very likely. Once a pirate, always a pirate. But he's a charming old rogue.
Not a half bad cook, truly. Must have been that squirrel diet, it seems to have lead him to discover a new cuisine - everything to forget the bad taste of squirrels, he said.
He is proficient in the martial arts. A very skilled teacher of spells for knights and paladins. If that is your vocation, you should talk to Ser Tybald.
Ah, yes. Travelled with Plunderpurse a lot as I recall. Captain Plunderpurse, then. Got his head full of numbers and statistics, that boy.
Each vocation has their own unique spells to enhance their fighting or defense, which none of the other vocations can use, and which you can only learn at a spell trainer of your vocation.
Most of the major cities are on the Tibian mainland, such as the rich merchant city of Venore, for example. You will find spell teachers for your vocation in almost every major city.

Tibia is the world we live in. Rookgaard is not far off from the Tibian {mainland}, though it's a tricky passage with contrary winds. On the mainland, you will find more adventure, mystery and monsters and can prove yourself a hero or villain.

A very intelligent girl. Prefers to listen to wild animals' noises instead of humans', which is quite understandable when you think about it. However, she's also a very apt healer and can give you advice on your choice of vocation.

Your choice of vocation will determine your life in Tibia, and the skills and fighting techniques you may use. There are four vocation: knight, druid, paladin and sorcerer. If you want to know more about them, talk to Oressa in the temple. I myself teach try-out spells for both the magical classes, whereas Tybald in the next room specialises in knight and paladin spells.

Very young and sometimes precipitate, burning for everything mystical, holy, godly, which is not a bad thing as such. Just a little hasty and prone to fall into a nest of monsters now and then, but he always comes out alive.
How should I know where that key has gotten to? I rarely sleep at my age anyway! Though I must say that my young adventurer fellows handled it quite carelessly, from what I saw.

greet: Chhhhzzz. Ugly humanzzz! You better have a good reazzzon to be here!
Hehehe.
farewell: Hope you die and lose it.

reply: Barbarians are stupid.
Bronbronbronbronbron. Bronnnn!
Can I have free outfits?
That's me.
Ajax is even more stupid.
You are as stupid as Bron.
Any cyclops is smarter than Bron.
Roses are red, and so is blood.

greet: Have you come to answer Gelidrazah's questions?
Greetings, dear visitor.

reply: I am known as Geoffray.
My role here is quest contact.

greet: Greetings. You don't have to shout, my ears are very good! Besides I'm quite busy, as you may see.

reply: I'm Georgia Rainbird.
I'm a scientist. I took great pains to build up this laboratory. Researching the glooth, its characteristics and risks is my self-imposed life task. ...
I do my researches even at the expense of my health.
This is a slimy substance which is produced by the glooth worms. It was a driving force for the progress in Rathleton. A substance that has great potential but also carries some risks.

reply: This place is a sanctuary of Crunor and provides me with a opportunity of spiritual contemplation.
I'm a member of a circle of persons, that joined wisdom and resources for a common purpose. Let's say, we have an eye on the greater picture in the matters of our world. ...
We are watching and evaluating what is happening in our world.Trying to avert the worst and offering a helping hand where we deem it needed. ...
We usually avoid to interfere directly in the affairs of the world and vain politics are not our concern at all.
We focus our interest on this we see as threatening for live and the laws of nature itself.
Well, while I focus more on the matters of life, some of my peers have different approaches and emphasize other aspects of the world more in their observations. ...
Regardless we share a common goal of balance and harmony.
We might not be many but we are diverse. Our rather informal order came together in the dawn of time, when the wars of the gods ravaged the world.
Even we know the individual that was somewhat of our funder, only as the wise man. ...
He was the first to bring bright and dedicated minds together, to bring at least a little order and guidance into troubled and chaotic times. ...
The order predates mankind and never bothered to give itself a name. Such assumptions of pretence and vanity have no place in our mindset.
Most times we are silent watchers and keeper of knowledge that share what they have learned with each other. We are more concerned about knowledge and wisdom and power means little to us. ...
To solve problems we usually try to convince the right people to do the right thing. We usually even lack the means for a more direct interference.
Sometimes it's necessary to do something about a situation that became threatening to the world itself. ...
It is gladly a rare occurrence and usually it is sufficient to somewhat offer a guiding hand to avert a course that would lead to more dire consequences. Nonetheless sometimes we have to interfere.
Interference comes in different forms. In this particular case there is sadly little time for subtlety and a more direct approach is necessary.
The fae granted me permission to enter their hidden realm. As a druid I'm in close touch with nature so I could gain their trust. The nature spirits are inhabiting this peninsula for ages.

The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...

Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the 'children of dreams' or 'the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
Fauns are half-human, half-beast nature spirits inhabiting the woods and mountains of Feyrist. They are a slightly roguish but cheerful folk, lovers of wine and dancing. ...

Fauns show a youthful and graceful aspect but they are also brave and fearless when it comes to defend themselves. As Maelyrra told me, they emerge from mortals' dreams about celebrations, music and dancing. ...
Lately, some fauns on Feyrist are tainted by the mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
Pixies are small nature spirits and mythical creatures inhabiting the forests and plains of Feyrist. They are generally benign, but at times, they may also display mischievous traits. ...

Like most of the fae, pixies love dancing and are often gathering in larger groups to dance on secluded glades. Pixies love flowers, butterflies, shimmering beetles, gems and other colourful things. ...
They also love the taste of honey, sweetened oat and ripe grapes. As Maelyrra told me, pixies emerge from mortals' dreams about friends and family.

Pookas are nature spirits in animal form, looking like big hares with a faintly glittering fur. They are benign but mischievous, for sure with good reason regarded as the tricksters among the fae. ...

Pookas love to play pranks on others, snitching and hiding things or telling made-up stories. They are capricious and fickle creatures. Pookas emerge from mortals' dreams about gems, treasures and gold. ...
Lately, some pookas on Feyrist are tainted by a mysterious, sinister force that is threatening Feyrist as well as the rest of Tibia.
Swan maidens are fae who can shapeshift from human form to swan form. The magical item allowing this transformation is a swan feather cloak, a garment with swan feathers attached. ...
Here on Feyrist it is always hard to tell whether a swan swimming on a lake is an ordinary animal or a swan maiden in her bird shape. ...
They protect the wilds of their secret realm from every intruder and live in small flocks along secluded lakeshores. As Maelyrra told me, swan maidens emerge from mortals' dreams about flying.

Nymphs are female nature spirits and usually take the form of beautiful, young maidens who love to dance and sing. They dwell in the hills and forests of Feyrist, often near lakes and streams and they can't die of old age nor illness. ...
They have a special, strong bond to the plants and animals of their domain and are very protective of Feyrist's flora and fauna. As Maelyrra told me, nymphs emerge from mortals' dreams about love.
Boogies are a rather twisted kind of fae. Other than pixies, nymphs or fauns they favour underground caves and tunnels over forests or lush meadows. ...

Only at night, they are roaming the surface, chasing other fae and visitors to Feyrist alike. They were once clumsy yet peaceful fae, but they are now twisted and tainted by a mysterious, sinister force.
She's the queen of a fae court. You can find her on a glade in the deep forest. It was queen Maelyrra who granted me permission to stay here in Feyrist. ...
I promised to inform her about anything I find out about the abominable force that threatens this world.

The fae vary greatly in size and appearance. There are different kinds of fae like fauns, pixies, pookas, swan maidens, nymphs and boogies. Those mystical creatures are wielding power in magic and elementals. ...

Most of them are rather reclusive and live peaceful lives in their secret realm. Sometimes they are called the ,children of dreams' or ,the dream born' because the fae are born from the mortals' dreams.
It doesn't seem that the cults share a common theme or object of reverence but there has to be some connection beyond being at the centre of culminations of disruptive power from beyond. ...
The connection is of second thought though. Connected or not, they further the death of our world. That alone makes it imperative to dig those cults out and destroy their cores. ...
We won't be able to rout our each and any movement but if we manage to neutralize the worst, we gain some time and deny the enemy much of its leverage on the future of our world.
We have located some of the worst culminations of otherworldly presence and our sources returned information about them with different results of success. ...
Some information I can provide you will be rather sparse and much is left to speculation but you should have at least some lead where to go and investigate.
Those cults have to be stopped by any means possible. These are desperate times and they demand desperate actions.
Spare lives where you see it fit but the cults may not be allowed to exist and disrupt the fabric of the world even more.
The weakened fabric of our reality still repels the unnatural intruder. The cults provide the thing a hold and supply it with more power, even if we couldn't figure out yet, how this works at all.
We haven't completely figured out what our enemy exactly is. For one, this thing defies all laws of nature and comprehension, ...

that understanding it is either impossible or twist a mind in ways that are not meant to be. Also the Yalahari who figured out way too much about the thing, became tainted and changed by this knowledge ...
And ultimately not only fell and became his, they also provided the thing with something of their own, be it knowledge, understanding or even direction, purpose. ...
In some way their tainted knowledge brought the unthinkable into a resemblance of existence. ...
That is why we cant dabble too much in figuring this out and rather concentrate on our fight to severe its ties to our world.
I have several missions available that deal with servering the ties of the corrupting influence on our world.
